【浦發銀行董事長張為忠：金融行業與人工智慧“雙向賦能”】6月18日，在2026陸家嘴論壇“全體大會六：科技創新賦能金融高質量發展”上，浦發銀行董事長張為忠表示，金融行業與人工智慧的關係，同人工智慧與其他行業的關係相比，其本質區別在於“雙向賦能”。張為忠表示，一方面，金融行業積極擁抱前沿技術。由於金融行業應用場景豐富、技術密集且服務群體龐大，必然會選擇在人工智慧技術應用上快速突進。另一方面，是金融反過來支援和賦能科技產業的發展。當前，人工智慧正處於時代前沿，金融機構一定會透過風險投資、科創信貸、資本市場以及保險保障機制的建設，來大力支援人工智慧的發展。

Philippine Central Bank Hikes Rates as Expected — The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 bps to 4.75% at its May 2026 policy meeting, matching market expectations and marking a second consecutive rate hike as it moves to contain persistent inflationary pressures. The Monetary Board said inflation risks remain elevated, driven by sustained high global oil and fertilizer prices, which continue to feed into domestic fuel and food costs amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East. The BSP projects that average headline inflation will breach its 4.0% target ceiling in both 2026 and 2027, before easing slightly but remaining above the 3.0% midpoint target in 2028. Annual inflation slowed to 6.8% in May 2026 from a three-year high of 7.2% in April, but it remains above the central bank’s 2%–4% target band, as the country is particularly exposed due to its heavy reliance on imported energy from the Middle East. The overnight deposit and lending facilities were also adjusted to 4.25% and 5.25%, respectively.

【英鎊受英國就業資料影響不大，市場正關注英國央行決議】在投資者等待英國央行今日晚些時候的政策決議之際，英鎊對最新的英國就業資料反應平淡。截至4月份的三個月，失業率從上一季度的5.0%降至4.9%。經濟學家此前預計為5.0%。同期不包括獎金的平均收入增長3.4%，高於預期的3.2%。英國央行將於格林威治時間1100公佈決議，普遍預計將維持利率不變。焦點在於關於今年晚些時候是否可能加息的任何指引。英鎊兌美元上漲0.2%，至1.3313美元，高於資料公佈前的1.3298美元。然而，歐元兌英鎊持平於0.8560英鎊，與資料公佈前相比幾乎沒有變化。

【萬馬科技子公司優咔科技獲北汽集團海外流量專案定點】近日，萬馬科技全資子公司上海優咔網路科技有限公司（簡稱“優咔科技”）獲得北京汽車集團有限公司（簡稱“北汽集團”）海外流量專案定點，覆蓋GCC、非洲、中西亞及大洋洲共20個國家和地區。優咔科技將為北汽集團旗下自主品牌乘用車提供基於海外流量的定製流量方案、本地化落地與啟用支援、流量使用檢測與運維保障以及合規性管理等全流程能力，確保車輛出海即可穩定聯網。

【兩艘沙特油輪出現在霍爾木茲海峽之外海域 之前在迪拜附近】由沙烏地阿拉伯國家航運公司Bahri控制的兩艘滿載石油的超級油輪出現在阿曼灣，它們上次發出訊號是兩個月前位於波斯灣。船舶追蹤資料顯示，Shaden號和Jaham號油輪週四清晨在波斯灣外的富查伊拉附近海域開始發出訊號。它們上次一次被人看到是在4月份，地點位於波斯灣內的迪拜附近海域。這些超大型油輪載有約420萬桶原油，是2月下旬從沙特的Juaymah港和Ras Tanura港裝載的；但就在幾天後，美國和以色列襲擊了伊朗。

【存量銀行轉債將在2028年全部到期】銀行轉債又將“減員”，紫銀轉債和青農轉債將於7月和8月先後到期，屆時銀行轉債數量將進一步減少。今年至今銀行轉債暫無新增發行，市場供需失衡問題持續加劇。業內分析指出，上市銀行普遍破淨壓制轉債新發節奏，短期供給難以明顯回暖；疊加板塊正股走勢偏弱，投資者轉股意願低迷，轉債補充核心一級資本的核心功能難以落地，優質高評級銀行轉債或將成為場內稀缺配置底倉。據統計，除了紫銀轉債和青農轉債之外，剩餘4只銀行轉債都將在2028年10月之前到期，其中，常銀轉債、重銀轉債是2028年到期，上銀轉債和興業轉債是2027年到期。最晚到期的銀行轉債是常銀轉債，將於2028年9月15日到期。（21財經）

UK Employment Rises Above Expectations — The number of employed people in the United Kingdom rose by 100 thousand to 34.410 million in the three months to April 2026, following a 148 thousand increase in the previous period and above forecasts of a 75 thousand gain. This was mainly driven by growth in full-time employment, while part-time work declined over the quarter. Compared with a year earlier, employment increased by 399 thousand, reflecting gains in both full-time and part-time workers, with the rise in full-time employment driven by employees and the increase in part-time work supported by self-employed workers. Despite this, the employment rate for those aged 16 to 64 remained unchanged at 75.0%, both over the quarter and compared with a year earlier, following a period of relative stability since mid-2024. Meanwhile, the number of people holding second jobs declined to 1.277 million, accounting for 3.7% of total employment.

【菲律賓央行再次上調基準利率 以抑制伊朗戰爭引發的通脹】菲律賓央行連續第二次會議提高基準利率，儘管美伊達成臨時和平協議，但該行仍為應對可能持續的通脹做準備。菲律賓央行週四將目標逆回購利率上調0.25個百分點至4.75%，與接受調查的30位經濟學家中23位的預測一致。此前有7位經濟學家預計加息50個基點。儘管美國和伊朗同意重新開放對能源供應至關重要的霍爾木茲海峽，但亞洲各國央行持續收緊貨幣政策，凸顯了謹慎態度。日本央行週二上調政策利率，並承諾將進一步加息以抑制通脹風險。預計印尼央行將於週四跟進。

Coal Extends Decline on US-Iran Deal — Thermal coal futures fell below $145 per ton, extending their retreat from near three-year highs after the US and Iran signed an interim peace agreement that paves the way for the reopening of the crucial Strait of Hormuz. The development pushed energy prices lower and reduced incentives for fuel switching. The agreement also includes the lifting of sanctions on Iranian oil exports, while negotiations on nuclear issues and potential additional economic incentives for Iran will follow. The prolonged disruption had previously driven energy importers across Asia and Europe to seek alternatives to Persian Gulf natural gas, with Japan and South Korea notably increasing coal consumption during the conflict. Meanwhile, coal prices had surged to multi-year highs earlier this month after Indonesia tightened export controls on key commodities, a move expected to delay shipments from the world’s largest coal exporter.

Swiss Trade Surplus Widens to Over 1-Year High — Switzerland’s trade surplus widened sharply to CHF 5.6 billion in May 2026 from an upwardly revised CHF 3.3 billion in the previous month, marking the largest surplus since April 2025. Exports climbed 3.4% month-on-month to a more than one-year high of CHF 25.4 billion, driven mainly by chemical and pharmaceutical products (25.7%) and jewellery and precious metal goods (14.7%), despite a 4% decline in watch. Exports to Europe rose the most, up 18.5%, with shipments to Slovenia more than doubling (111.8%), while exports to North America increased 10.3%, led by the US (11.5%). Meanwhile, imports rose 3.4% from a month earlier to a three-month high of CHF 19.8 billion, led by higher purchases of chemical and pharmaceutical products (11.7%) and machinery, electronics and equipment (1.1%). By region, imports increased from Europe (5.9%) and the US (11.2%). In contrast, imports declined from Asia (-2.6%), led by China (-4.3%), Japan (-19.6%), and Hong Kong (-24.4%).

【‘Silence is golden’ Fed stance splits market; policy path uncertain】Market views split after a Fed official’s 'silence is golden' line leaves the policy path unclear. Goldman: if inflation remains elevated by September, the Fed could hike as early as September/this autumn and may follow with one–two additional hikes. Former Fed economist Sam: no clear trigger now to respond to supply-driven inflation, but the case for action is building. Huatai Securities: no rate move before September; ~50% chance of a December hike; cumulative two hikes possible by end of next year. Danske Bank: sees two hikes possible over the next 12 months, with a September move if data stay stronger than expected. BNP Paribas: warns the market shock could come if an individual Fed official proves more hawkish than Powell; projects three consecutive hikes beginning in December. On the dovish side, Nordea: still sees scope for two cuts but pushed into 2027 with a first cut at the March 2027 meeting. Citi: now forecasts 25bp cuts in Oct and Dec 2026 and Jan 2027 (revising earlier calls for cuts this year). UBS: even if a US‑Iran deal eases oil, the Fed will wait for confirmation that inflation is past the threat—cuts only from March 2027 in UBS’s view. Barclays expects rates to remain unchanged through 2027. JP Morgan: Fed unlikely to move rates this year as the committee appears patient. Nomura: the dot plot has not fully priced oil weakness after US‑Iran talks; future policy will hinge on non‑energy price trends. CITIC Securities: leans toward the cited official not supporting a year‑end hike and expects the FOMC split to converge toward the chair; anticipates unchanged policy this year. China International Capital Co: expects no rate moves this year but rising upside risk next year if US growth accelerates on AI capex. ING: does not see a current need to hike but cannot rule out future hikes and says any hike would likely be reversed quickly.

UK Total Pay Growth Stays Strong — Total average weekly earnings in the UK, including bonuses, rose 4.1% year-on-year to GBP 753 in the three months to April 2026, matching the upwardly revised increase in the previous period and slightly exceeding market expectations of 4.0%. The pace remained the fastest since the three months to November 2025. Private sector wage growth eased marginally to 4.2% from 4.3%, which had been the strongest since the three months to September 2025. In contrast, public sector pay growth accelerated to 5.2% from 4.9%, rebounding from its weakest pace since late 2024. Adjusted for inflation, total earnings increased 1.2%, up from 1.1% in the three months to March and marking the strongest real wage growth since the three months to April 2025.

【農業銀行董事長谷澍：智慧體的定義和規範標準尚未統一】6月18日，在2026陸家嘴論壇“全體大會六：科技創新賦能金融高質量發展”上，中國農業銀行董事長、執行董事谷澍表示，智慧體目前在金融業的應用非常普遍，都在積極探討和佈局。但究竟什麼是智慧體？行業內的定義還需要進一步規範與統一。例如，各家銀行在彙報AI應用成果時，都會提到開發了多少個智慧體，差異非常大：有銀行表示開發了幾百個，有銀行則聲稱達到了上萬個。在他看來，這主要源於目前智慧體的定義和規範標準尚未統一。谷澍表示，如果缺乏比較規範的標準，很難界定到底什麼樣的應用才算是一個成熟的智慧體。在這種情況下，很難準確評估各家機構在行業中的相對位置，也就難以有效借鑑他人的長處，從而推動整個行業在智慧體應用水平上的共同提升。“智慧體本質上是讓大模型真正運轉起來的中介、代理或執行者，其開發過程存在很大差異。”谷澍建議，在設計智慧體來代替人類工作時，能否將那些功能相對單一、業務流程比較固定的智慧體做成“標準件”，這樣的好處在於可以避免重複開發，實現反覆呼叫，從而能把更多精力聚焦於開發具備自主規劃和決策能力的智慧體上，這將更有意義，也更具效率。

UK Payroll Employment Rises 2K in May — The number of payrolled employees in the UK rose by 2 thousand to 30.3 million in May 2026, after a revised 53 thousand drop in April. This was the first monthly increase after three consecutive months of decline amid the Middle East conflict. On an annual basis, employment fell by 0.4%, or 119 thousand. The largest decrease was seen in the accommodation and food service activities sector (-80 thousand), while the biggest rise was in the administrative and support services sector (+34 thousand). Across NUTS3 regions, Westminster recorded a 2.3% decline in payrolled employees, while Mid Ulster registered a 1.9% rise. 【China tells UNCLOS meeting it rejects 'South China Sea arbitration' ruling as illegal】China's deputy UN permanent representative Sun Lei told the 36th meeting of states parties to UNCLOS on the 17th that certain states have revived the so-called 'South China Sea arbitration' and China must clarify its position. He said the arbitration violated the principle of state consent, the tribunal exceeded its jurisdiction and misapplied the law, and its award is illegal and void. He called the case a political provocation cloaked in legal form aimed at denying China's territorial sovereignty and maritime rights; China has never accepted or recognized the award and its South China Sea territorial and maritime rights remain unaffected.

UK Jobless Rate Unexpectedly Falls to 4.9% — The UK unemployment rate fell to 4.9% in the three months to April 2026, defying expectations that it would remain at 5.0%. The number of unemployed people declined by 105 thousand to 1.764 million, driven by a decrease in those unemployed for up to six months, while the number of those unemployed for between six and 12 months was broadly unchanged and those out of work for more than 12 months fell. Compared with the same period a year earlier, however, unemployment increased by 124 thousand, as the number of people unemployed for between six and 12 months and for over 12 months rose. Meanwhile, total employment increased by 100 thousand to 34.410 million, topping expectations of a 75 thousand rise, and was also up 399 thousand from a year earlier, driven by an increase in full-time workers, partly offset by a decline in part-time employment. The number of people holding second jobs decreased in the latest quarter to 1.277 million, accounting for 3.7% of all employed individuals.

UK Wage Growth Tops Forecasts — Regular pay in the UK, excluding bonuses, rose 3.4% year-on-year to GBP 697 per week in the three months to April 2026, matching March's pace while exceeding market expectations of 3.2%. It remained the weakest increase since the three months to October 2020, with private sector wages slowing to 2.9% from 3.1%, the lowest since the three months to October 2020. Meanwhile, public sector pay accelerated to 5.1% from the prior 4.8%, which had been the softest since late 2024. By industry, annual gains were seen in wholesale, retail, hotels, and restaurants (3.5%), manufacturing (3.1%), services (3.6%), and finance and business services (2.5%), but declined for construction (-0.7%). Adjusted for inflation, real wages edged up 0.1% in the three months to April, keeping the same pace as in the previous period and staying at the lowest level since mid-2023.

Nomura flags a possible 25bp move in July with easing only next year; Fitch and others also see potential rate cuts resuming next year. Political and oil-price moves are key market levers—Rabobank warns BoE caution plus a UK by-election could weaken sterling, and TD Securities notes a sharp oil drop would reduce near‑term hike odds. Berenberg highlights a weaker UK labour market versus the eurozone, reducing BoE’s inclination to tighten relative to the ECB.

NZX 50 Extends Losses, Ends 0.2% Lower — The NZX 50 fell 30 points, or 0.2%, to close at 13,363 on Thursday, extending losses from the previous session, mainly weighed down by utilities, financials, and healthcare stocks. The broader index tracked a decline on Wall Street overnight after the Fed held interest rates steady and signaled the possibility of rate hikes this year. Wednesday's data also continued to pressure sentiment, as New Zealand's consumer confidence fell to its lowest level since 2023 in Q2, while the Q1 current account deficit widened from the same period a year earlier. However, fresh data helped cap the fall, as New Zealand's GDP growth accelerated to 0.8% qoq in Q1, while annual growth held steady at 1.5%. Reports that the US and Iran had digitally signed an interim peace agreement also boosted sentiment, as lower oil prices eased concerns over inflationary pressures. Among notable losses were Mainfreight (-2.8%), AFT Pharmaceuticals (-1.7%), Westpac Banking Corp. (-1.6%), and South Port NZ (-1.1%).

【A股“科技化”程序或將顯著加速，中國核心科技資產或迎來全球定價時刻，A500ETF南方（159352）衝擊4連漲】6月18日，A股股價最高的四隻千元股——聯訊儀器、源傑科技、寒武紀、中際旭創均創歷史新高，截至發稿，A500ETF南方（159352）漲0.73%，衝擊四連漲，成交額25億元。長江證券表示，一方面，A股“科技化”程序或將顯著加速，市場成為技術創新的孵化器；另一方面，中國核心科技資產或迎來全球定價時刻，人民幣外匯期貨的研究推進，將為外資配置中國資產提供更完善的匯率風險管理工具，利好外資長期流入。國投證券認為，當前AI科技正在經歷的是左側階段性高切低，基於產業浪潮股最終結束M頂視角下第一個頂部大機率還未到來，綜合宏觀“灰犀牛”並不明確（海外流動性收緊預期存在反覆）以及AI資本開支高位難以驗偽，本輪AI科技抱團眼下不會輕易結束，其核心大主線定位並未隨著股價高位波動而受到動搖。資料顯示，A500ETF南方（159352）緊密跟蹤的中證A500指數覆蓋A股大中盤優質龍頭企業，重點佈局新質生產力，憑藉規模、流動性等方面優勢，或是助力資金佈局後市機會的有力工具。投資者可借道A500ETF南方（159352）及其聯接基金（A類022434；C類022435）一鍵佈局。

【分析認為美聯儲面臨多股力量相互角力的挑戰】Moneyfarm首席投資官Richard Flax在一份報告中表示，美聯儲面臨的挑戰在於，目前有多股力量在相互角力。他說：“短期來看，考慮到對勞動力、材料和能源的需求，投資週期（尤其是圍繞AI和基礎設施的投資週期）看起來可能會引發通脹。“他表示，從長期來看，一個更可信的觀點是，技術可能會帶來通脹放緩。因此，Flax說，就目前而言，維持利率不變與其說是猶豫不決，不如說是認識到政策框架已經處於相當具有限制性的水平。“降息的門檻仍然很高，除非我們看到經濟活動出現更明顯的放緩，或者通脹出現更令人信服的回落，否則美聯儲可能會在一段時間內按兵不動。”

Kyrgyzstan Industrial Output Growth at 3-Month Low — Industrial production in Kyrgyzstan grew by 13.4% year-on-year in May 2026, slowing from a 16.8% rise in the previous month. This marked the softest growth in industrial activity since February, largely due to a 3.4% output drop (vs 3.6% in April) in electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply. Production growth also slowed for mining and quarrying (6.4% vs 7%) and manufacturing (16.9% vs 20.7%). On the other hand, activity surged for water supply, wastewater and waste management, and material recovery, climbing 27.3% after a 9.5% gain in the prior month. In the first five months of the year, industrial output expanded by 14.4%, compared to a 12.9% growth recorded in the same period a year earlier.

【聯合國報告：去年受武裝衝突影響兒童人數創紀錄】 聯合國秘書長“兒童與武裝衝突問題”年度報告17日釋出。報告顯示，經聯合國確認，受武裝衝突影響的兒童人數去年達到24174人，創下自30年前聯合國該報告首次釋出以來的最高紀錄。報告還說，2025年，兒童仍是被綁架為童子軍或遭受性侵害的物件，針對兒童的強姦及其他性暴力案件數量未見減少。30年來，國家行為體首次成為武裝衝突中侵害兒童的主要施害者。（新華社）

【國家發展改革委：把中國產業競爭力歸因於“補貼”的說法完全錯誤】近期有國際機構釋出報告稱，中國企業在一些關鍵領域全球市場份額增長主要得益於政府補貼。對此，國家發展改革委新聞發言人今天在新聞釋出會上回應，把中國的產業競爭力簡單歸因於“補貼”，不僅過於片面，而且完全錯誤。中國的產業競爭力，是多方面因素共同作用的結果。

國家發展改革委新聞發言人李超表示，中國的現代化產業體系是在長期實踐中不斷摸索、總結、提升而發展起來的。中國的產業競爭力來自超大規模市場的高強度淬鍊，來自完整產業體系的高效協同，來自教育、科技、人才的長期積累。

李超表示，中國擁有全球規模最大、門類最齊全、體系最完備的製造體系。近年來，“義烏請量產”成為社交媒體的熱詞，讓天馬行空的想法在短時間內就變成產品的，正是完整產業體系提供的強大適配能力、快速響應能力、穩定交付能力。紮根中國的企業在這樣一個“什麼都能造、造什麼都好”的體系中，可以實現競爭力快速煥新升級。

中國的產業競爭力還來自營商環境的持續最佳化。中國將持續為各類企業提供公平競爭、競相發展創造良好環境，反對將經貿問題政治化、工具化，願意與各方一道，深化務實合作，共同構築安全穩定、暢通高效、開放包容、互利共贏的全球產業鏈供應鏈體系。

【 大藤峽水利樞紐工程正式透過竣工驗收 】 今天，大藤峽水利樞紐工程正式透過水利部主持的竣工驗收，標誌著工程建設任務全部完成，全面轉入常態化正式執行階段。 大藤峽水利樞紐是國家水網重要節點工程，也是落實國家江河戰略、推進江河保護治理的骨幹工程，集防洪、航運、發電、補水壓鹹、灌溉等綜合效益於一體。工程總投資357.36億元，總工期9年。總庫容34.79億立方米、防洪庫容15億立方米，正常蓄水位61米。在提升流域水安全保障水平、服務粵港澳大灣區國家戰略、促進地方經濟社會高質量發展等方面發揮重要作用。

【嬰幼兒紙尿褲檢出毒性物質甲醯胺，多家品牌回應】據《經濟參考報》報道，近期，有消費者反映，使用部分品牌嬰幼兒紙尿褲後，嬰幼兒出現反覆紅臀乃至皮膚破潰，停用後症狀明顯緩解。為核實投訴線索，記者委託專業檢測機構對市場上部分品牌嬰幼兒紙尿褲開展抽樣檢測，結果在“好奇”“碧芭寶貝”“Babycare”等多個品牌的嬰幼兒紙尿褲中，檢出毒性物質甲醯胺。醫學檢測機構也在部分嬰幼兒血液、尿液中檢出該物質。對此，多家品牌釋出宣告回應：
碧芭寶貝運營團隊釋出宣告稱，公司所有嬰幼兒紙尿褲均嚴格遵循國家母嬰用品相關生產標準，出廠前經過多重合規檢測。報道抽樣檢測樣本來源、檢測環境、檢測流程尚未與我司完成核驗，暫無法判定樣本真實性與代表性，公司已主動聯絡涉事檢測機構，同步申請第三方權威複檢，完整覆盤全鏈路生產、原料、倉儲環節。甲醯胺為明確管控有害物質，公司供應鏈體系明令禁止該類原料新增，將即刻對全部原材料、生產線開展全面篩查，杜絕風險隱患。後續權威複檢結果將第一時間全渠道公開，主動接受消費者與行業監督。
Babycare釋出宣告稱，公司在售紙尿褲產品，均嚴格遵循現行國家標準。截至目前，公司未收到任何市場監管部門關於抽檢不合格的正式通知或反饋。前期公司已主動依據歐盟REACH法規中的SVHC（高關注物質）要求，對紙尿褲進行檢測，甲醯胺專案檢測結果均為“未檢出”。針對報道中提及的檢測結果及方法，因國內尚無明確統一標準，公司已主動聯絡相關媒體，希望對方提供樣品來源、檢測方法及依據，以便進一步核實。同時，公司已委託多家第三方權威檢測機構，對全系列紙尿褲開展獨立抽檢，並全程進行公證，檢測過程及結果接受社會各界公開監督。
好奇品牌釋出宣告稱，近日，網路上出現關於“好奇品牌紙尿褲產品檢出甲醯胺”的相關報道及傳言，引發部分消費者擔憂。經權威第三方機構檢測，好奇品牌紙尿褲未檢出“甲醯胺”成分，各項指標符合我國嬰兒紙尿褲相關國家標準。

【特朗普稱蘋果將與英特爾合作在美國生產晶片】美國總統唐納德·特朗普週四在Truth Social上發文稱，蘋果已同意與英特爾合作，在美國設計和製造其晶片。據媒體5月報道，在經過一年多的磋商後， 英特爾已達成 初步協議，將為蘋果生產部分晶片。與英特爾達成協議有助於蘋果在尋求擴大晶片產能的同時，實現製造基地的多元化。該公司目前高度依賴臺積電，而臺積電的先進生產線正受到英偉達和AMD等人工智慧晶片製造商的熱烈追捧 。

Dutch Jobless Rate Holds at 3.9% — The Netherlands’ seasonally adjusted unemployment rate stood at 3.9% in May 2026, unchanged from the previous month and still the lowest level since last August. The number of unemployed people increased by 2 thousand to 399 thousand, while 3.2 million people were outside the labor force, which mainly consists of retirees and individuals unable to work due to illness or disability. At the end of May, the number of unemployment benefits stood at 199,400, down 1.8% from the previous month, as 19,000 new claims were added while 22,800 were terminated. Meanwhile, employment dropped by 24 thousand to 9.829 million, while the labour force declined by 22 thousand to 10.23 million, primarily because more people left the labor market while fewer non-workers found jobs. The gross labor force participation rate edged down to 76.1% from 76.2%, as well as the net participation rate to 73.1% from 73.3%. In May 2025, the jobless rate stood at 3.8%.

Palm Oil Slips After Holiday Break — Malaysian palm oil futures fell below MYR 4,500 per tonne, reversing the previous strong rally, as trading resumed after a holiday. Sentiment was pressured by weaker edible oil prices on the Dalian and Chicago markets. A sharp decline in crude oil prices added to the downside after the U.S. and Iran signed an interim agreement aimed at ending hostilities and reopening the Strait of Hormuz, reducing support from the biofuel sector. Meanwhile, Malaysia lowered its July crude palm oil reference price, keeping the export duty unchanged at 10%. Still, losses were limited by a weaker ringgit and expectations of lower production due to the lingering effects of El Niño. Demand prospects also remained supportive after cargo surveyors reported that palm oil exports during June 1–15 rose between 9.6% and 23.8% from the same period in May. In top buyer India, imports are expected to exceed 600,000 tonnes in June after edging up to 549,356 tonnes in May, according to local traders.

【MIIT, MOFCOM and three ministries organise 2026 NEVs-to-countryside drive; push connected-vehicle, new charging/swapping, PV+storage+charging and vehicle-grid interaction in rural areas】The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, MOFCOM, the NDRC, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and the National Energy Administration will organise a 2026 new-energy-vehicles (NEV) to-countryside campaign. The notice calls for coordination with existing initiatives such as the "Thousand Counties, Ten Thousand Towns NEV Consumption Season" and the selection of counties with low NEV penetration but high market potential for targeted offline events. Authorities will run model displays, test drives and other in-person experience formats, supplemented by livestreaming and online consultation to drive rural footfall to dealerships and boost offline retail. NEV dealers, after-sales maintenance and charging/swapping operators, plus insurance and credit providers, will be mobilised to support rural deployment and improve service and infrastructure. The campaign also directs promotion of intelligent connected-vehicle technologies, new charging and swapping technologies, integrated photovoltaic+storage+charging systems and vehicle-grid interaction in rural areas.

【MIIT, MOFCOM and four agencies to run 2026 NEVs-to-the-countryside campaign】China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and MOFCOM, together with the NDRC, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and the National Energy Administration, will organize a 2026 NEVs-to-the-countryside campaign. The notice directs expansion of old-for-new vehicle trade-in activity in rural areas, requires dedicated trade-in zones within the campaign, and mandates promotion of subsidy policies while providing one-stop services — old-car inspection, valuation, recycling and subsidy-application handling — to raise policy awareness and coverage and make it easier for rural consumers to claim subsidies. Rural consumers who trade up to NEVs may apply for the vehicle old-for-new subsidy per policy requirements and are not subject to limits on the number of subsidy entitlements.

【五部門：開展2026年新能源汽車下鄉活動 深入推進汽車以舊換新進鄉村】工信部等五部門辦公廳（綜合司）釋出關於開展2026年新能源汽車下鄉活動的通知。通知指出，選取滿足鄉村地區使用需求、口碑好、質量可靠的新能源車型，有關車型目錄在“新能源汽車下鄉服務平臺”公眾號中動態更新。落實車購稅、車船稅減免、縣域充換電設施補短板等政策，積極擴大新能源汽車鄉村地區消費。深入推進汽車以舊換新進鄉村。在新能源汽車下鄉活動中設定以舊換新專區，開展補貼政策宣介推廣，提供舊車檢測評估回收、補貼申請手續代辦等“一站式”服務，進一步提高優惠政策知曉度、覆蓋面，便利鄉村地區消費者參與享受補貼。對換購新能源汽車的鄉村地區消費者，均可按政策要求申領汽車以舊換新補貼，不受補貼資格數量限制。

【光大理財：2025年中國資管市場規模增至175萬億元，行業轉向“量質並重”】6月17日，光大銀行、光大理財釋出《中國資產管理市場2025-2026》報告。光大理財董事長王景春在釋出會現場表示：“2025年中國資產管理市場的規模達到175萬億元，同比增長12.1%，連續兩年保持快速增長，行業展現了很強的發展韌性。”報告指出，中國資管行業已從單純的規模擴張，轉向“質”與“量”並重的高質量發展階段。當前，資金結構持續最佳化，居民財富穩健流入，養老資金加速擴容，為長期資本形成提供了有力支撐；同時，產品創新與渠道佈局更趨多元，資產配置能力不斷拓展，行業正以更成熟的姿態服務實體經濟與居民財富管理需求。 報告顯示，在利率“1時代”背景下，居民資產再配置漸成浪潮，境外投資提速升級，人工智慧技術正深刻重塑行業能力體系。報告研究認為，資管行業應立足“固本培元”，以穩健的固收基本盤和漸進式權益配置承接居民財富再配置需求，在服務國家戰略和居民福祉中實現自身的高質量發展。

Copper Falls as Oyu Tolgoi Exports Resume — Copper futures dropped below $6.4 per pound on Thursday, giving back gains from earlier in the week after Rio Tinto resumed exports of copper concentrate from its giant Oyu Tolgoi mine in Mongolia following a brief protest-related disruption. Oyu Tolgoi is among the world’s largest copper mines and remains central to Rio Tinto’s strategy to increase production of a metal critical to electrification, the energy transition, and growing demand from data centers. Copper also faced pressure after the US Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged on Wednesday but signaled increasing support for rate hikes later this year. The prospect of higher borrowing costs clouded the outlook for global economic activity and industrial metals demand. Meanwhile, the US and Iran signed an interim peace agreement that is expected to lead to the reopening of the strategically important Strait of Hormuz.

【Analyst: SpaceX valuation decoupled from AI sector health, reflects Musk trust premium】Analyst Dan Taylor says SpaceX’s valuation is increasingly decoupled from the AI sector and looks driven more by a personal trust premium in CEO Elon Musk than by an AI-driven growth case. Taylor judges Musk’s US$1 trillion revenue target by 2030 unlikely, but says investor confidence in Musk’s track record continues to support the valuation. The pace of upcoming AI-related IPOs will hinge on whether the current AI spending surge endures. 【《廣東省粵港澳遊艇自由行管理辦法》印發】廣東省人民政府辦公廳印發《廣東省粵港澳遊艇自由行管理辦法》，其中提出，本辦法適用於經指定口岸入出內地且僅限在粵港澳大灣區內地九市自由行的港澳遊艇（簡稱“港澳遊艇”）、駕駛人員及其乘客的管理。本辦法所稱粵港澳大灣區內地九市（簡稱“內地九市”），是指廣州市、深圳市、珠海市、佛山市、惠州市、東莞市、中山市、江門市、肇慶市。港澳遊艇依照本辦法取得電子臨時船舶國籍證書，並辦結進口岸查驗手續後，可在內地九市水域航行，在具備條件的停泊點停泊，在劃定的休閒活動水域範圍內進行水上休閒娛樂活動，在內地九市水域按照內地船舶相關制度進行管理。港澳遊艇在臨時船舶國籍證書有效期內，可以多次入出內地，在內地每次連續停留或者每年累計停留均不得超過180天。

【 俄稱莫斯科等多地遭無人機或導彈襲擊 】 俄羅斯莫斯科市市長索比亞寧18日在社交媒體發文稱，俄羅斯防空系統當天擊落了至少28架飛向莫斯科的無人機。俄羅斯布良斯克州代理州長科瓦爾丘克當天在社交媒體釋出警告稱，有導彈飛向布良斯克州。同時，羅斯托夫州州長斯柳薩里表示，羅斯托夫州前一天遭無人機襲擊，造成1人死亡，另有2人受傷，而無人機襲擊仍在持續。此外，俄羅斯別爾哥羅德州當天凌晨也遭到無人機襲擊。對此，烏克蘭方面暫未作出回應。

【最新研究揭示青藏高原凍土風化碳抵消機制】傳統觀點認為，多年凍土融化會釋放大量老碳，透過河流向大氣排放二氧化碳，從而加劇全球變暖。然而，我國科學家的一項最新研究認為，多年凍土融化雖然會讓河流釋放更多二氧化碳，但同時也會加速岩石的自然風化過程，這種風化能吸收一部分二氧化碳，形成一個以前被忽視的天然“碳儲存庫”。一項由北京師範大學與中國科學院青藏高原研究所聯合完成的研究發現，氣候變暖導致多年凍土退化，不僅釋放了封存的有機碳，同時也將大量活性礦物暴露出來，顯著增強了水巖相互作用。這一過程能將水體中的二氧化碳轉化為溶解無機碳，實現地質尺度的碳封存，從而有效減少河流向大氣的淨碳排放。（央視新聞）
【香港下午停課】香港天文臺今日（18日）發出紅色暴雨警告訊號。香港特區政府教育局宣佈，由於紅色暴雨警告訊號現正生效，下午校的學生今日下午無需上課，但學校須保持校舍開放，同時安排應變措施，照顧已返抵學校的學生。正在上課的學校應繼續上課，直至放學時間，並在安全情況下，方可讓學生返家。 如果香港天文臺於下午五時或之前改發黃色暴雨警告訊號或取消所有暴雨警告訊號，除非另行通知，夜校今晚將照常上課。

【巴西總統警告特朗普勿插手巴西選舉】巴西總統盧拉6月17日在瑞士日內瓦對美國總統特朗普喊話，要求特朗普“不要干涉”巴西今年的選舉。盧拉說，特朗普有權持有自己的選舉與意識形態偏好，但別插手巴西選舉。盧拉還表示，如果特朗普只是透過與巴西前總統博索納羅家族的關係來了解巴西，那他就並不真正瞭解巴西。特朗普當天早些時候在七國集團峰會結束後的記者會上稱，巴西前總統博索納羅之子愛德華多·博索納羅“被捕”，巴西已變得“政治上危險”。6月16日，巴西最高法院裁定愛德華多·博索納羅脅迫司法罪名成立，其被控在海外發起遊說活動，施壓外國政府幹預其父的政變案審判。不過，由於愛德華多·博索納羅目前居住在美國，本次審判為缺席審判。博索納羅的另一個兒子弗拉維奧·博索納羅則被認為是今年巴西總統大選中盧拉的主要競爭對手之一。

【紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890）半日成交超9億領跑同類！業內：分紅兌現+風格切換是主因 高股息邏輯未破】6月18日，三大指數漲跌互現，創業板指漲超1%，滬指跌0.37%。在此背景下，紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890） 早盤下跌1.84%，報1.119元，換手率2.77%，半日成交額9.05億元，成交規模居同類ETF首位。資金流向上，紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890）長期受資金青睞，近5個交易日資金淨流入7億元，近20個交易日資金淨流入26.3億元，近60個交易日資金淨流入34.6億元。截至2026年6月17日，該ETF流通規模330.28億元。業內分析指出，本輪銀行股連續回撥主要受分紅兌現、風格切換等短期因素驅動，並非行業基本面惡化。當前銀行淨息差基本築底，資產質量保持穩健，板塊4%至6%的高股息仍具備配置吸引力。機構預判下半年銀行防禦屬性凸顯，行情以結構性機會為主，高股息大行及區域優質城商行的估值修復空間值得期待，投資需持續跟蹤息差、資產質量等核心變數。光大策略表示，整體來看，短期A股或偏震盪，中長期來看，在基本面及產業趨勢的雙重支撐下，有望逐漸震盪上行。短期內，防禦板塊或有階段性表現，例如高股息及價值股，不過此類機會或許更偏交易層面的情緒演繹。中長期來看，高景氣方向仍是配置核心。投資者可將紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890）作為底倉配置，無股票賬戶的投資者也可透過其場外聯接基金進行配置（A類：007466；C類：007467；I類：022678；Y類：022951）。

【AI-driven rally lifts chip stocks; South Korea's KOSPI tops 9,000 for first time】Chip stocks rallied on AI optimism, pushing South Korea's KOSPI up 1.54% on Thursday to breach 9,000 for the first time and mark a record high. Heavyweight Samsung Electronics rose more than 2%; SK Hynix jumped over 5%. Amid the AI-led global rally, Korea is among the top-performing markets — the KOSPI is up 114% YTD after a 76% gain last year.

【機構：SpaceX的估值並未反映AI板塊的整體健康狀況】英仕曼集團的Dan Taylor在評論中表示，SpaceX的估值並未反映AI板塊的整體健康狀況。該火箭公司的股票表現似乎更多是對執行長埃隆·馬斯克的押注，而不是一個AI故事。Taylor表示，該公司不太可能在2030年前實現馬斯克1萬億美元的收入目標，但他之前的創業專案表明，投資者對他的信心並不缺乏，這應該是支撐SpaceX的因素。後續AI相關上市專案的儲備可能取決於AI支出熱潮的永續性。他補充說，科技股已經出現分化，一方面是與半導體相關的大漲，另一方面是軟體即服務公司的下跌，並且這種分化可能會持續下去，直到AI投資的商業回報變得更加清晰。
【中國赴阿卜耶伊維和直升機分隊透過聯合國裝備核查】當地時間6月16日，中國第六批赴阿卜耶伊維和直升機分隊透過聯合國第二季度裝備核查，所有物資裝備全部符合任務標準。聯合國阿卜耶伊臨時安全部隊核查組採取實地檢視、現場清點、功能測試、資料核對等方式，對營房設施、通用車輛與直升機裝備、武器彈藥管理、醫療救護裝置等24項內容逐項檢查驗收。分隊官兵熟練講解裝備效能和操作流程。

【Omdia: XR headwear to return to growth in 2027 as industry shifts from headsets to glasses】Omdia forecasts global XR headwear shipments will fall 12% in 2026 to 6.2 mln units, then rebound 4.8% to 6.5 mln units in 2027. The firm says the recovery will be driven by rapid expansion of XR glasses, which should offset ongoing declines in bulkier headsets as consumers and manufacturers increasingly favour lighter glasses form factors.

【首程控股(00697)參投國泰海通砂之船商業REIT和中信建投首農商業REIT】首程控股(00697)公佈，近日，該集團所屬首程基石旗下公司(公司的全資附屬公司)參與投資國泰海通砂之船封閉式商業不動產證券投資基金(國泰海通砂之船商業REIT)和中信建投首農食品集團封閉式商業不動產證券投資基金(中信建投首農商業REIT)。該兩項投資有助於進一步促進居民消費升級，推動金融與實體經濟相融並釋放發展動能，對深化產融協同、促進經濟高質量發展具有積極作用。

【Omdia：XR頭戴裝置市場預計2027年重返增長，行業重心從頭顯轉向眼鏡形態】Omdia最新預測，全球XR頭戴裝置（XR headwear）出貨量將在2026年下降12%，降至620萬臺。然而，市場預計將在2027年恢復增長，達到650萬臺，同比增長4.8%。此次復甦主要將由XR眼鏡的快速擴張推動，並抵消XR頭顯出貨下滑的影響。消費者和廠商正越來越傾向於更輕便的眼鏡形態，而不是體積更大的頭顯裝置。

【朱寧：AI可能給三個領域帶來意想不到的衝擊或變革】6月18日，在2026陸家嘴論壇“全體大會六：科技創新賦能金融高質量發展”上，上海交通大學上海高階金融學院（高金）金融學教授朱寧表示，AI可能給三個領域帶來意想不到的衝擊或變革。一是對微觀層面個人行為的衝擊。這不僅會導致人們對錯誤資訊或虛假資訊產生過度依賴，還會引發過度自信的膨脹，讓人產生“無所不知”的錯覺。同時，它還會帶來博弈層面的影響。以導航系統為例，當所有人都相信並依賴同一套導航資訊時，原本規劃的最不擁堵的路線，往往會因為大量車輛的湧入而變成最擁堵的路線，這在經濟學上被稱為“合成謬誤”。在AI場景下，人的行為模式會發生改變，這種改變可能會進一步加劇人類的行為偏差或非理性決策機制，這是我們需要高度關注的風險點。二是從倫理和社會學的角度來看，人類究竟應該與AI保持怎樣的關係？隨著AI對社交媒體內容的貢獻度越來越高，下一階段是否會對AI和AIGC的成長方式與速度進行限制？這已成為全社會都需要深入探討的重要議題。三是關於AI治理結構的國際合作。當前，人們普遍期望AI能夠向善、賦能並助力人類。但如果AI發展出自主能力，或者落入別有用心的人手中，它可能會生成虛假資訊、產生“幻覺”，甚至有意識地對人類或特定企業做出不利行為。面對這些情況，究竟該由誰來治理？誰來監管？誰來懲處？這些問題在全球範圍內尚無定論，且整個治理體系仍在快速演變之中。
【好奇嬰幼兒紙尿褲被曝檢出甲醯胺，金佰利客服這樣回應】6月18日，有媒體報道稱在“好奇”“碧芭寶貝”“Babycare”等多個品牌的嬰幼兒紙尿褲中，檢出毒性物質——甲醯胺。其中，“好奇”為美國金佰利旗下品牌。6月18日上午，金佰利客戶服務電話工作人員回覆稱，公司會核實相關情況，目前還無法給出回應。（第一財經）

【Wall Street urges US regulators to further loosen Basel capital rules】Wall Street banks are pressing US regulators to loosen proposed Basel global bank capital standards, warning the draft could weaken liquidity in the $29 trillion US Treasury market and urging a rethink, the Financial Times reports. The Treasury market’s potential instability has become the focal point of industry lobbying. Under pressure, the Fed and other regulators have already substantially watered down the original proposal; the rules are now expected not to materially raise aggregate US bank capital and could even lower it. A letter from eight large US banks estimates the latest proposal would raise capital requirements for Treasury-related bank activity by 30% to 89%.

【高盛亞太總裁：中國科技投資空間巨大 建議最佳化資本對接與退出機制】在2026陸家嘴論壇全體大會五上，高盛集團亞太區總裁Kevin D. SNEADER表示，中國科技創新已邁入轉折點，AI技術有望在十年內貢獻中國勞動生產率的8%。他指出，當前中國在AI相關領域的絕對投資額為美國的約10%，存在顯著增長空間，資本缺口集中於初創與成長階段，亟需構建市場驅動的早期融資體系，引入“耐心資本”並強化公司治理。SNEADER建議，政策層面應進一步明確監管指引，提升中段融資的審批效率與可預期性；同時拓寬機構投資者退出渠道，以加速資本迴圈。

【滙豐王雲峰：十分期待上海繼續深化金融高水平對外開放】滙豐銀行（中國）有限公司行長兼行政總裁王雲峰在出席2026陸家嘴論壇期間表示：“在本屆陸家嘴論壇上，《上海國際金融中心發展離岸金融行動方案》正式出臺，並有多項金融舉措釋出。其中支援人民幣離岸交易、推進離岸金融業務、促進內地與香港資本市場聯動發展等重點舉措，不僅進一步拓展了金融高水平開放的廣度和深度，也為外資金融機構發揮所長、加碼投資提供了明確的工作抓手。”同時，在談到上海國際金融中心發展時，王雲峰指出：“我們十分期待上海繼續深化金融高水平對外開放，結合其在產業、科創以及金融基礎設施等方面的獨特優勢，進一步推動人民幣在貿易、投資和金融等領域的跨境應用，併為中資企業出海提供強大的金融助力。”

【Hong Kong midday: Hang Seng down 1.7%, slips below 24,000】The Fed held rates unchanged and several officials signaled possible hikes later this year; US stocks fell overnight and the China Golden Dragon index tracked lower. Hong Kong equities reopened down after two straight declines: Hang Seng opened 166 points lower at 24,145 and plunged as much as 444 points to an intraday low of 23,868, breaching the 24,000 level. Japan Signals Readiness to Respond to Yen Moves — Japan stands ready to act if needed to address excessive exchange-rate volatility, Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara said on Thursday. He added that the government is prepared to respond to market moves at any time, stating, "We are ready to respond appropriately to currency moves as needed at any time." He added that officials will continue to closely monitor foreign exchange developments. Kihara noted that while a weaker yen benefits manufacturers by boosting export competitiveness and corporate profits, it also raises import costs, increasing the burden on businesses and households through higher prices. "We need to scrutinise such effects comprehensively," he said, highlighting the government's balanced assessment of the currency's impact on the economy.

【香港金管局回應美聯儲議息決定：繼續密切監察市場變化，維持貨幣及金融穩定】香港金管局回應美聯儲議息決定表示，美聯儲維持息率不變的決定符合市場預期。會後發表的宣告表示通脹仍處於較高水平，反映委員會對通脹前景的關注。香港方面，貨幣及金融市場保持有序運作。港元拆息在聯絡匯率制度下整體上趨近美元息率，而較短期限的拆息就同時受本地市場港元資金供求影響，例如季節性因素及資本市場活動。美國息率的變化將取決於通脹走勢、就業市場情況和其他經濟資料，對香港的利率環境亦會有所影響，市民在作出置業、投資或借貸決定時，需充分考慮及管理利率風險。金管局會繼續密切監察市場變化，維持貨幣及金融穩定。（香港金管局）

【HKMA response to Fed decision: will continue to monitor markets and preserve monetary and financial stability】The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the Fed’s decision to hold rates met market expectations and that inflation remains elevated, reflecting policymakers’ concerns. Hong Kong money and financial markets remain orderly. Under the Linked Exchange Rate System HKD interbank rates broadly track USD rates, but short-term Hibor can diverge due to local HKD liquidity conditions such as seasonality and capital-market activity. US policy moves will depend on inf, employment and other data and will affect Hong Kong’s rate environment; market participants should factor rate risk into property, investment and borrowing decisions. HKMA will continue to monitor markets closely to maintain monetary and financial stability.

Indian Rupee Retreats on Firmer Dollar — The Indian rupee hovered around 94.6 per dollar, retreating from recent gains as the US dollar strengthened after the Federal Reserve concluded its latest policy meeting. Investors reassessed the interest-rate outlook after the Fed unanimously left its benchmark rate unchanged at 3.5%–3.75%, while updated projections signaled a notable shift in policymakers’ expectations. Further pressure on the rupee came as US Treasury yields climbed, with the two-year yield rising 12 basis points, supported by a series of resilient economic indicators that reinforced the case for higher-for-longer interest rates. Meanwhile, crude oil prices continued to move lower after the United States and Iran reached an interim agreement to halt the conflict and restore traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, easing concerns over energy supply disruptions.

【Bank of Korea: gap between overseas investment income and repatriation weakens won】A Bank of Korea study finds overseas investment income supports the won less than expected because a large share of returns are retained and reinvested abroad rather than repatriated, creating a gap between the recorded investment income surplus and actual FX inflows. As overseas asset positions have grown rapidly, the effect has intensified and helps explain why the won remains relatively weak despite strong semiconductor exports and a near‑record current account surplus. The won has depreciated over 5% year‑to‑date, one of the weakest performances in Asia. The report says policymakers should monitor repatriation rates as well as income size; it estimates a roughly 3% increase in overseas asset stock above the average would push USD/KRW about 0.7 percentage points higher, reflecting stronger dollar demand, while an 8% rise in investment income above the mean could lower the rate by about 0.4 percentage points.

【上海自貿離岸債集中意向簽約儀式舉行】6月17日，上海自貿離岸債集中意向簽約儀式順利舉辦。工商銀行、農業銀行、中國銀行、建設銀行、交通銀行、中信建投證券、浦發銀行及國泰海通證券分別與相關合作方完成簽約，擬發行自貿離岸債的主體包括我國“走出去”企業的海外子公司、金融機構海外分支機構以及“一帶一路”沿線國家和地區的優質企業等。自貿離岸債是開展離岸金融先行先試、推動金融高水平開放的重點領域。2026年陸家嘴論壇上，中國人民銀行等六部門聯合釋出《上海國際金融中心發展離岸金融行動方案》，進一步支援上海自貿試驗區分賬核算單元（FTU）在專項額度內投資自貿離岸債，為自貿離岸債的規模化運作提供流動性保障。與之配套，國家金融監管總局釋出《關於商業銀行開展浦東新區自貿離岸債業務有關事項的通知》，推動商業銀行規範有序開展承銷等自貿離岸債業務。

【今起山東實施2026年消費品以舊換新地方自主品類補貼】據“山東釋出”，今天（6月18日）上午，山東省人民政府新聞辦公室舉行政策例行吹風會，邀請省商務廳負責同志等解讀《山東省2026年消費品以舊換新地方自主品類補貼實施方案》。為進一步提升消費品以舊換新政策實施質效，滿足群眾多元化消費需求，省商務廳等5部門印發《山東省2026年消費品以舊換新地方自主品類補貼實施方案》，自6月18日（今天）起正式實施，至2026年12月31日結束。本次納入全省自主補貼範圍的共8個品類，包括掃地機器人（含洗地機）、助行類外骨骼機器人、智慧馬桶、吸油煙機、家用燃氣灶（含整合灶）、淨水器、洗碗機、助聽器。

TAIEX Nears Record High, Up 1.2% — The TAIEX, Taiwan’s benchmark stock index, climbed 530 points, or 1.2%, to 46,411 in Thursday morning trade, rising for the fifth straight session, mainly buoyed by electronic technology, finance, and technology services stocks. The broader index was close to a record high of 46,459, reached on June 3, when it surpassed the 46,000 level for the first time, as optimism over AI demand continued to lift sentiment. Reports that the US and Iran had digitally signed an interim peace agreement also boosted sentiment, as lower oil prices eased concerns over inflationary pressures. However, a downbeat session on Wall Street overnight capped gains after the Fed kept interest rates steady and signaled the possibility of rate hikes this year. Electronic technology stocks gained 1.2%, with TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, which accounts for more than 40% of the market's total value, rising 1.1%. Meanwhile, Delta Electronics and ASE Technology rose 0.9% and 2.9%, respectively.

【A-share midday: ChiNext up 1.39% at half-day, hits near 11-year high】A-share market mixed at midday: ChiNext rose 1.39%, trading near an 11-year high, while the STAR 50 index advanced more than 3% and also set fresh highs. Shanghai and Shenzhen turnover reached 2.14 trillion yuan by midday, up 187.6 billion yuan from the prior session; more than 3,400 stocks were down, signalling a narrow advance. Industrial metals and semiconductors led gains; semiconductor names Cambricon climbed over 13% and GigaDevice rose more than 8%, both hitting new highs. CPO-related stocks remained active. On the downside, the insurance sector tumbled—PICC, China Life and Ping An each fell over 5%—while power utilities and airport/airline stocks underperformed.

China 10Y Yield Extends 3-Session Decline — China's 10-year government bond yield fell to around 1.72% on Thursday, extending losses for a third consecutive session and hitting a more than one-week low, as the growing role of bond financing could support the People's Bank of China's efforts to lower borrowing costs. The shift toward bond issuance reflects China's ongoing transition to a high-tech, innovation-driven economy, where capital market funding often offers cheaper financing than traditional bank loans. Government and corporate debt accounted for a record 30% of China's outstanding credit stock in May. Meanwhile, the People's Bank of China has been supporting liquidity conditions in the 200 trillion yuan bond market through policy operations, helping to keep yields low and ease funding costs across the economy. Separately, investors are closely watching the final session of the Lujiazui Forum for further policy signals and potential support measures.

【中國工商銀行劉珺：以科技思維重構金融產品和服務】6月18日，在2026陸家嘴論壇“全體大會五：健全科技金融全生命週期服務體系，服務實體經濟高質量發展”上，中國工商銀行副董事長、行長劉珺表示，當前經濟正在發生四個極致變化：首先是資源配置的極致效率。全球尖端科技企業的規模在前所未有擴充套件的同時，對資源獲取、配置、整合能力也在以幾何級數提升。二是企業成長的極致速度。尤其前沿科技企業在初創期帶有很強的規模效應，一旦跨過算力閾值，會在極短時間內躍升為所謂獨角獸、十角獸、百角獸，反之很快被市場淘汰。三是市場供需的極致互動。四是人才供給的極致組合。劉珺表示，下一步，圍繞科技金融，工商銀行將從三方面進一步開展工作：一是以科技思維重構金融產品和服務，包括流程、產品組合以及交付方式，都要用新科技做新一輪的重塑；二是推動時間的貼現邏輯向技術的期權邏輯轉換；三是搭建互動式的金融平臺。

【中國銀行行長張輝：人工智慧正在重塑銀行業發展正規化】6月18日，在2026陸家嘴論壇“全體大會六：科技創新賦能金融高質量發展”上，中國銀行副董事長、行長張輝表示，人工智慧正在重塑銀行業的發展正規化，主要是表現在三個方面：一是重塑服務正規化，AI改變了銀行和客戶之間資訊資料傳輸和處理的方式，讓兼顧普惠性、專業性、個性化的數字金融服務成為可能。二是重塑價值創造的模式，金融業的資訊密集、流程清晰、規則明確，這點和大模型的自動化、智慧化的核心能力高度匹配，透過深度嵌入到銀行的客服、營銷、審批、風控、運營等各個環節，可以更有效地促進銀行降本增效，大幅拓展價值創造的空間。三是重塑銀行業的管理正規化，人工智慧深度應用，需要對銀行的組織架構、隊伍建設、管理機制、治理體系、風險能力等方面都進行系統性的重構，從而實現從原來的經驗驅動、人力驅動向資料驅動、智慧驅動的轉變。

【農業銀行董事長谷澍：可用AI手段應對AI應用風險 以AI對抗AI】6月18日，在2026陸家嘴論壇“全體大會六：科技創新賦能金融高質量發展”上，中國農業銀行董事長、執行董事谷澍表示，面對大模型應用過程中的風險，能做的不是消除風險，而是在發揮好大模型作用同時，也要認識到大模型的侷限性，想辦法儘量控制風險。他認為可從四方面防控大模型應用過程中的風險：一是分類施策推進場景適配。金融應用大模型的時候是應用在不同的場景裡面，對於不同的場景，可以建立模型的黑箱的分級管控，不同場景匹配差異化的技術路線和可解釋性的要求。二是設定一定的標尺對大模型進行約束控制，大模型有時候會產生幻覺，有時候會自由發揮，針對不同的場景進行應用的時候是需要建立引數、建立標尺控制它的應用路徑。同時再把它和人結合起來，大模型過程里人的作用是最終做決策。三是用AI手段應對AI應用風險，以AI對抗AI，建立縱深防禦體系，增強AI對抗能力。四是強化銀行內部的AI治理體系，健全全生命週期和風險並重的銀行內部AI治理體系，確保AI既用得好又管得好，既留住創新空間又儘量壓縮模型黑箱、幻覺的侷限性。

【Analyst: Fed not yet ready to hike, but case for tightening is building】Fed officials signaled on Wednesday they may need to raise rates soon rather than cut, a sharp pivot amid rapidly rising inflation. Evercore ISI analyst Krishnan Guha said falling energy prices could ease inflation in coming months, but warned the rate outlook has decoupled from oil and the key uncertainty is whether underlying inflation will cool enough to avert eventual hikes. Guha flagged two additional upward pressures beyond energy: ongoing tariff pass-through and cost spillovers from a surge in AI infrastructure investment. Claudia Sahm, chief economist at New Century Advisors and a former Fed economist, said she does not yet see the usual triggers that would prompt a Fed response to supply-driven inflation — an overheated labor market or unanchored inflation expectations — but conceded the case for action is accumulating and that the Fed should be prepared to raise rates if conditions worsen. She added the Fed could move faster than it did during the pandemic inflation spike because the debate is already underway.

Rupiah Holds Near IDR 17,850 Ahead of BI Decision — The Indonesian rupiah traded near IDR 17,850 per U.S. dollar on Wednesday, little changed from the previous session, as traders awaited the central bank's interest rate decision later in the day. Policymakers are widely expected to raise the benchmark rate by 25bps, following cumulative 75bps of tightening since May, to support the rupiah and reinforce inflation expectations. While tighter monetary policy should help stabilise the local currency, higher borrowing costs could further weigh on domestic demand. Investors also weighed local reports of a new stimulus package for lower-middle-income households, alongside unchanged subsidized fuel and LPG prices. Jakarta, meanwhile, has cut funding for the flagship Free Meal Program by about IDR 67 trillion as President Prabowo pursues fiscal efficiency. Externally, the dollar stayed firm after the Fed held rates but flagged growing support for hikes later this year, curbing gains across emerging-market currencies, including the rupiah.

【Agricultural Bank of China chairman Gu Shu says large AI models face three major risks】On June 18 at the Lujiazui Forum, Agricultural Bank of China chairman Gu Shu outlined three main risk categories for large AI models. First, explainability: mainstream models now run to hundreds of billions or trillions of parameters, and massive matrix operations and nonlinear superposition make decision mechanisms and outputs opaque and hard to interpret. Second, accuracy: models generate by probabilistic token prediction from training data rather than logical fact‑based deduction, so insufficient data or grounding can produce coherent but false hallucinations. Third, autonomy risk: evolving models and agentic applications are moving beyond fixed input‑output software paradigms to autonomous reasoning and decision‑making, increasing process uncontrollability and outcome uncertainty.

【農業銀行董事長谷澍：大模型當前面臨三大類風險】6月18日，在2026陸家嘴論壇“全體大會六：科技創新賦能金融高質量發展”上，中國農業銀行董事長、執行董事谷澍表示，在應用大模型過程中，AI大模型當前面臨的主要風險包括模型黑箱、模型幻覺、模型自主思考和決策帶來的不確定性。在他看來，這種不確定性風險可進一步細分為三大類:一是引數海量帶來模型可解釋性的難題。現在主流大模型的引數規模已經有千億甚至萬億級別，海量引數的矩陣運算和生成非線性疊加導致模型的決策機制和輸出結果不透明，也很難解釋。二是機率生成帶來準確性的考驗。大模型決策過程不像人類進行決策時有線性思維的過程，而是根據海量訓練資料統計詞源token的機率性規律，本質上是機率統計，不是邏輯性的事實推導。當資料和事實依據不足時，容易產生自洽的幻覺。三是模型現在已能自主思考和決策了，隨著大模型的進化和智慧體的深度應用，它已突破傳統軟體輸入輸出相對固化的正規化，能夠自主思考，這在一定程度上放大了過程不可控、結果不可知的風險。

【國家發改委：經雲霄直流優先發電計劃開展的電力交易，將優先獲得輸電權】國家發展改革委政策研究室副主任、新聞發言人李超在新聞釋出會上表示，需要強調的是，為了保障通道安全、電力供應穩定，雲霄直流輸電權市場化交易將堅持“安全為錨、穩妥為要、公平公開、競爭有序”的原則，在實施過程中將重點把握好以下三方面要求。一是保供優先，經雲霄直流優先發電計劃開展的電力交易，將優先獲得輸電權；優先發電計劃之外的通道容量，由閩粵兩省優先使用；剩餘部分再以季度為單位釋放給市場。二是穩定價格，現階段對雲霄直流輸電權設定0.0256元/度—0.1元/度的限價區間，保障通道成本回收和用電成本穩定。三是共享收益，購電方支付的輸電權費用，全部用於抵充閩粵兩省承擔的雲霄直流容量電費，按月向兩省工商業使用者分享，預計每年至少可減輕兩省工商業使用者電費約5000萬元。

【國家發改委：加快實現新增清潔能源發電量覆蓋全社會新增用電需求】6月18日，國家發展改革委政策研究室副主任、新聞發言人李超在新聞釋出會上表示，實現碳達峰碳中和，既是實現高質量發展、推進人與自然和諧共生的現代化的必然要求，也是我國作為負責任大國對國際社會的莊嚴承諾。我們將與有關部門和地方一道，從存量和增量兩個方面同步發力。存量方面，聚焦鋼鐵、電解鋁、水泥、平板玻璃、煉油、乙烯、合成氨、甲醇、煤電等9個重點行業，實施節能降碳改造攻堅三年行動，為“兩高”領域新增專案實施碳排放等量或減量置換騰出更多空間。增量方面，推動新增專案最佳化能源結構，積極發展綠色直供等新模式，提升非化石能源使用比例，降低碳排放水平。下一步，我們將推動各地方擴大對零碳園區、零碳運輸走廊等領域的投資力度，加快實現新增清潔能源發電量覆蓋全社會新增用電需求，持續培育綠色低碳發展新動能。（中國網）

【國家發改委：將持續做好對雲霄直流輸電權市場化交易的跟蹤指導，適時向其他跨省跨區通道推廣】國家發展改革委政策研究室副主任、新聞發言人李超在新聞釋出會上表示，雲霄直流輸電權市場化交易啟動後，有關方面積極參與。6月11日—12日，北京、廣州兩個電力交易中心聯合組織了首筆輸電權交易，預成交安徽送廣東電量2116萬千瓦時，其中包括綠電1607萬千瓦時，本次交易共有113家經營主體參與申報。下一步，國家發展改革委將會同有關部門，持續做好對雲霄直流輸電權市場化交易的跟蹤指導，及時評估並梳理有關經驗和效果，適時向其他跨省跨區通道推廣，促進全國富餘電力跨區域流動，啟用輸電通道資產效能，加快構建規則統一、運轉協同的全國統一電力市場體系。

【CHINA STATE PLANNER to accelerate ensuring new clean power generation covers all incremental electricity demand】CHINA STATE PLANNER spokesman Li Chao said authorities will pursue parallel stock-and-flow measures to meet carbon peak and neutrality targets. On stock, a three-year energy-saving and carbon-reduction retrofit campaign will target nine sectors — steel, electrolytic aluminium, cement, flat glass, refining, ethylene, synthetic ammonia, methanol and coal power — to free space for new high-energy, high-emission ("two-high") projects through emissions-equivalent or emissions-reducing replacement. On flow, new projects will be steered to optimize energy mix, expand green direct-supply models, raise non-fossil fuel use and cut carbon intensity. The planner will push local governments to boost investment in zero-carbon parks and zero-carbon transport corridors and accelerate ensuring new clean energy generation covers all incremental electricity demand to cultivate green, low-carbon growth drivers.

【韓國監管機構就槓桿股票投資發出警告】韓國金融市場監管機構週四釋出投資者警告，提醒投資者注意近期推出的個股槓桿投資產品。近期晶片股引領韓國市場漲勢，其表現領先全球。“近期股市波動率上升，出現了個股槓桿或反向投資產品短期內劇烈波動的情況，”韓國金融監督院(FSS)在一份宣告中表示，“因此，金融監督院釋出消費者警告，提醒散戶投資者注意風險，並敦促其謹慎做出投資決策。”上個月，韓國券商獲得監管部門批准，可以推出與三星電子以及SK海力士掛鉤的個股槓桿投資產品。

【Trump Iran deal splits allies; Netanyahu isolated as UAE backs pact - Axios】According to Axios, President Trump on Wednesday announced and signed an Iran agreement Israeli officials call a strategic and political disaster. Prime Minister Netanyahu — who had vowed Israelis a "comprehensive victory" over Iran — has remained publicly silent, accepted Trump's memorandum of understanding and continued presidential criticism with Israel's election four months away. Netanyahu says the deal is wrong and advocates continuing the war against Iran, but is largely internationally isolated; even the previously hardline UAE has shifted to support the pact. In Washington, Republican and media allies are reluctant to repudiate a Trump‑endorsed agreement, making a repeat of Netanyahu's 2015 congressional gambit unlikely. Israeli officials are airing strong concerns only in background briefings, and outlets once firmly pro‑Netanyahu/pro‑Trump have begun criticizing Trump and his team.

【河南靈寶足療店火災調查報告公佈 14名公職人員被問責】河南省應急管理廳公佈了三門峽靈寶瀾風足療店“5·2”較大火災事故調查結果。2026年5月2日，三門峽靈寶市瀾風足療店發生一起火災事故，造成6人死亡，直接經濟損失813.7萬元。經查，這是一起因未及時熄滅祈福使用的蠟燭引燃周邊可燃物，經營方主體責任不落實，違規經營，未按規定巡查，消防控制室無人值守，未及時發現並處置火情，屬地黨委政府及有關部門和單位履職不到位而導致的責任事故。瀾風足療店、錦祥盛物業公司5名責任人員，涉嫌刑事犯罪，被司法機關採取強制措施。對瀾風足療店、錦祥盛物業公司存在的違法違規問題，由有關部門依法作出行政處罰。紀檢監察機關依規依紀依法對事故中存在失職失責問題的屬地黨委政府及有關部門和單位14名公職人員進行了嚴肅問責。

Japan 10-Year Yield Stabilizes — Japan’s 10-year government bond yield steadied around 2.63% on Thursday as investors assessed recent central bank decisions alongside evolving geopolitical developments in the Middle East. The US Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged on Wednesday but signaled growing support for rate hikes later this year. At the same time, the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to 1% on Tuesday in an effort to curb inflation and support a weakening yen. However, the move drew dissent within the board, with Toichiro Asada arguing that downside risks to growth and employment outweigh upside risks to inflation. On the geopolitical front, the US and Iran digitally signed their interim peace agreement, though it remains unclear whether Iran has already begun steps to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

【嬰幼兒紙尿褲中檢出毒性物質甲醯胺，碧芭寶貝回應】6月18日，碧芭寶貝運營團隊釋出宣告稱，針對今日相關報道提及公司產品檢出甲醯胺相關內容，公司高度重視，第一時間啟動專項核查工作，現鄭重說明如下：1.我司所有嬰幼兒紙尿褲均嚴格遵循國家母嬰用品相關生產標準，出廠前經過多重合規檢測，始終將寶寶肌膚安全放在首位。2.報道抽樣檢測樣本來源、檢測環境、檢測流程尚未與我司完成核驗，暫無法判定樣本真實性與代表性，我們已主動聯絡涉事檢測機構，同步申請第三方權威複檢，完整覆盤全鏈路生產、原料、倉儲環節。3.甲醯胺為明確管控有害物質，我司供應鏈體系明令禁止該類原料新增，將即刻對全部原材料、生產線開展全面篩查，杜絕風險隱患。4.若家長使用產品過程中寶寶出現肌膚不適，可隨時聯絡品牌官方客服，我們將一對一跟進處理；後續權威複檢結果將第一時間全渠道公開，主動接受消費者與行業監督。

Zinc Remains Near 4-Year High — Zinc futures hovered below $3,600 per tonne but remained near a four-year high, supported by easing geopolitical tensions and tight near-term supply conditions. The US and Iran remotely signed a memorandum of understanding to end their war, alleviating fears about global economic growth and improving the outlook for industrial demand. At the same time, recent disruptions across major producers have reinforced supply concerns. Glencore’s Kazzinc facility in Kazakhstan is running at reduced capacity after an explosion, while Nexa’s Cajamarquilla smelter in Peru was temporarily suspended due to fire damage, though production is gradually resuming. Goldman Sachs also noted that Boliden’s Garpenberg mine in Sweden could operate at structurally lower output levels for longer after a seismic activity earlier this year. Meanwhile, the US dollar strengthened amid increased bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike, pressuring dollar-priced commodities.

【China International Capital Co: SOFC fuel-cell systems could become new data-center power solution】China International Capital Co said Bloom Energy and Nebius agreed in May 2026 to deploy 328 MW of SOFC capacity, with maximum service fees over the cooperation period of $2.6 bln. Bloom Energy’s annual capacity reached 1 GW by end-2025 and the company plans to expand to 2 GW by end-2026 to match AI data-center demand. CICC flagged SOFC systems as a potential new supply option for data centers and highlighted supply-chain implications: suppliers already integrated with Bloom Energy and other leading OEMs (diaphragms, magnetic components, cell-connection assemblies, temperature sensors) are candidates for upside; high-tech, low-localization BOP segments remain potential bottlenecks — in a 250 kW SOFC BOP example, heat-recovery system cost share rises from 17% to 23% as annual output scales from 100 to 10,000 units, with heat exchangers (requiring gas tightness and thermal-cycle durability) as core components. High-power burners and high-end air blowers (eg, magnetic-levitation) remain largely imported and require domestic technological breakthroughs.

【Shanghai Clearing House, China Foreign Exchange Trade System to launch FX repo optimization service on June 22, 2026】Shanghai Clearing House (SCH) and the China Foreign Exchange Trade System (CFETS) said on June 18 they will introduce an FX repo optimization service from June 22, 2026 to improve foreign‑currency repo trading and clearing and support market collateral management and diversified settlement. During the life of pledged FX repos, counterparties may initiate pledged‑security substitutions for unsettled trades via SCH’s integrated business system or CFETS’ FX trading system; substitutions take effect after counterparty confirmation. Before the trade settlement date, counterparties may initiate cash delivery in SCH’s system; SCH will complete buy‑out repo maturity settlement per cash‑delivery instructions. CFETS will publish its specific rollout timetable separately.

【Iran alleges Microsoft AI used to identify, prioritize targets in strikes】Iranian state media said a Microsoft AI called Claude, normally used for answering user queries, was repurposed in operations against Iran to identify and prioritize military targets. Tehran alleged the tool analyzed large volumes of satellite imagery, location data and communications signals to enable US and Israeli forces to select targets and recommend weapons in under a second. Iran said the system depended on cloud infrastructure provided by Amazon and Microsoft and that events in Tehran, Gaza and Lebanon exposed what it described as close ties between those tech firms and US/Israeli military operations.

【CHINA STATE PLANNER: Attributing China's industrial competitiveness to subsidies is wholly wrong】On June 18, Li Chao, deputy director of the policy research office and spokesman for the CHINA STATE PLANNER, rejected recent international reports that attribute Chinese firms' market-share gains in key sectors primarily to government "subsidies." US 10Y Yield Steadies on Hawkish Fed Signals — The yield on the 10-year US Treasury note held around 4.46% on Thursday after rising nearly 5 basis points in the previous session, as the Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged but signaled growing support for rate hikes later this year. Half of FOMC members now expect at least one rate increase, with the central bank sharply raising its inflation forecasts amid the economic impact of the conflict in the Middle East. Meanwhile, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declined to provide guidance on the next policy move but emphasized that inflation has remained above the Fed’s 2% target for several years and reiterated the central bank’s commitment to restoring price stability. On the geopolitical front, President Donald Trump signed an interim agreement to end the war with Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, though it remains unclear whether Iran has already begun steps to fully reopen the key shipping route.

【China State Planner to boost coordination between computing-power networks, new power grids and next‑gen communications】June 18 - Li Chao, deputy director of the Policy Research Office and spokesman for the China State Planner, said China has made progress on compute-power/power coordination and compute-network integration but still faces bottlenecks in planning, pricing and monitoring/dispatch technology. Over the 15th Five‑Year Plan period, the planner will prioritise supply–demand matching and tighten joint planning and construction of computing-power networks, new power grids and next‑generation communications. In ‘hard’ investment, it will pilot compute–electricity coordination models to prioritise power for compute and use compute to support power, advance compute–network integration and modestly expand direct trunk links between national hubs to cut transmission latency. In ‘soft’ measures, it will strengthen compute resource monitoring and market-based dispatch and accelerate construction of a nationwide, networked, accessible, green and secure integrated computing-power network.

Indonesia Equities Under Pressure on MSCI Assessments — Indonesian equities tumbled 126 points, or 2.0%, to 6,092 in Thursday morning trade, extending the prior session’s slide as caution deepened ahead of MSCI’s Global Market Accessibility Review later today and the June 23 Annual Market Classification Review, both critical for Indonesia’s benchmark status. Focus also turned to Bank Indonesia’s policy decision later today, with expectations of a hawkish stance after 75bps of hikes since May to bolster the rupiah and rein in inflation, though elevated borrowing costs risk further dampening demand. Sentiment found some relief from a sharp rebound in U.S. futures after the Federal Reserve, under new chair Kevin Warsh, held rates steady, as expected, while signaling a more cautious policy outlook. All sectors in local markets retreated, led by financials, infrastructure, industrials, and energy. Notable laggards included Telkom Indonesia (-7.8%), Transcoal Pacific (-6.6%), Elnusa (-5.7%), and Semen Indonesia (-3.8%).

【CHINA STATE PLANNER to issue 15th Five-Year special plan for modern logistics】June 18 — CHINA STATE PLANNER said it will issue and implement a 15th Five-Year special plan for the modern logistics sector. The plan will coordinate funding channels, support quality upgrades of existing logistics facilities and new construction, and develop a networked logistics infrastructure to better align facilities with industrial needs. It aims to densify urban-rural last‑mile networks and accelerate deployment of digitalized and green logistics facilities and equipment. The plan seeks to fill network gaps, improve connectivity and capacity, and shift logistics from basic availability to higher-quality, smoother operations. Target: by 2030 establish a logistics network with hubs closely coordinated with industry and consumption, corridors and networks connected internally and externally, green and intelligent facilities and equipment, and cross‑region rules and information interoperability to better serve high-quality real-economy development.

Heating Oil Falls to 3-Month Low — US heating oil prices fell toward $3.10 per gallon in June, reaching their lowest level since early March and shedding almost all of the gains during the Iran conflict, on expectations of a gradual normalization of energy exports from the Middle East. The US and Iran reportedly signed an interim agreement remotely, with Pakistan’s prime minister said the deal would lead to an immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and an end to the US naval blockade on Iranian ports. He added that the agreement commits both sides to permanently halt hostilities and opens a 60-day window to negotiate a final settlement on Iran’s nuclear program. However, President Trump warned that military action could resume if Tehran does not adhere to the terms of the 14-point memorandum of understanding. Following this, the IEA flagged a potential supply glut next year. Meanwhile, government data showed that distillate stockpiles, which include diesel and heating oil, rose by 0.951 million barrels in mid-June.

Yen Weakness Stokes Intervention Fears — The Japanese yen weakened to around 160.6 per dollar on Thursday, falling to its lowest level since July 2024 and heightening speculation that authorities could once again intervene to support the currency. The yen has now erased all of the gains recorded on April 30, when Tokyo carried out a record-setting intervention to stabilize the exchange rate. The latest decline came despite the Bank of Japan’s gradual policy tightening, including a 25-basis-point rate increase to 1% earlier this week aimed at countering an energy-driven inflation shock linked to the Middle East conflict. The currency remained under pressure as the dollar strengthened after the US Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged while signaling growing support for rate hikes later this year. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump signed an interim agreement to end the war with Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, easing concerns over Japan’s economy, which depends heavily on energy imports from the Middle East.

【Goldman Sachs: If inflation doesn't cool, Fed could hike as soon as September】Goldman Sachs vice chairman Kaplan, a former Dallas Fed president, said if inflation stays elevated the Fed may need to raise rates as soon as September. He said if inflation data does not cool between now and September, Fed action in September or this autumn would be prudent. Markets turned more hawkish after Fed chair Kevin Warsh signaled continued focus on fighting inflation; traders sold short-term Treasuries, lifting near-term yields. Warsh’s comments were reinforced by Fed members’ projections, with roughly half forecasting rate increases before year-end. Kaplan warned persistent inflation would imply policy remains too loose and noted Fed hikes rarely come as a single move — they typically occur in series of two or three, so a September hike would likely be followed by one or two more.

Platinum Slips Toward 6-Month Lows — Platinum futures fell below $1,770 an ounce, moving back toward six-month lows, pressured by a stronger US dollar after the Federal Reserve signaled growing support for interest rate hikes this year. While the central bank left its policy rate unchanged, nine Fed officials now expect a rate hike by the end of 2026. New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh refrained from providing guidance on the next policy move but stressed that inflation has remained above the central bank’s target and reiterated the Fed’s commitment to restoring price stability. Meanwhile, losses were capped as oil prices declined further after US President Trump signed an interim agreement to end the war with Iran, potentially reopening the Strait of Hormuz and easing inflation concerns. The platinum market also remains structurally tight, as output from major producers South Africa and Russia remains constrained by aging mines, high costs, and sanctions-related disruptions.

【Institutions: New Fed chair's first meeting passes initial test; independence to be tested】The Federal Reserve held rates unchanged at the new chair's first meeting. The chair said the Fed is united and committed to controlling inf. He ended the practice of issuing forward guidance ahead of the statement but the Fed released a dot plot showing nine officials expect rate hikes by year‑end, eight expect no change and one expects a cut. The chair did not submit a personal projection and said markets should price policy based on incoming data rather than Fed forecasts. He declined to say whether he has spoken to President Trump since taking office; Trump, who nominated him, has pushed for cuts but recently said the chair should 'do what he wants'. The dot plot’s distribution and removal of front‑loaded guidance shift emphasis to data‑dependent market pricing; the chair’s political independence will be a follow‑on market risk.

【CHINA STATE PLANNER, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security: adapt to AI to promote employment and tap emerging‑field job potential】CHINA STATE PLANNER and the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security said the Implementation of the Employment‑First Strategy (15th Five‑Year Plan) sets nine priority tasks, led by an employment‑first macro orientation and stronger macro‑policy coordination to support jobs. Hong Kong Stocks Fall for Third Session — The Hang Seng Index fell 360 points, or 1.5%, to 23,950 on Thursday, extending losses for a third consecutive session and the lowest since July 2025, as investors shunned risk after the Federal Reserve struck a more hawkish tone, signaling that further policy tightening may still be needed to contain inflation. The prospect of higher US interest rates lifted Treasury yields and the dollar while pressuring Wall Street overnight, dampening sentiment across Asian markets. Locally, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority left its base rate unchanged at 4.0%, mirroring the Fed's decision to hold rates steady. Investors also remained cautious amid lingering uncertainty over the global economic outlook and the potential impact of prolonged higher interest rates on corporate earnings and capital flows. Financial, technology, retail, and energy shares led the retreat, with notable losses from Kingboard Laminates (-4.3%), Pop Mart (-3.4%), Xiaomi (-2.5%), SMIC (-1.9%), and Tencent (-1.2%).

The deal also includes the permanent end to hostilities and initiates a 60-day negotiating period to reach a final agreement on the future of Iran's nuclear program, although Trump warned he would restart the war if Tehran fails to comply with the terms of the 14-point memorandum of understanding. 【美伊遠端簽署諒解備忘錄，60天談判視窗期開啟】巴基斯坦總理夏巴茲18日說，伊朗和美國遠端簽署的諒解備忘錄立即生效。作為第一步，伊朗將立即重新開放霍爾木茲海峽，美國將立即解除海上封鎖。美伊諒解備忘錄簽署儀式將於19日在瑞士舉行。美國白宮一名官員17日對美國哥倫比亞廣播公司說，美國和伊朗已遠端簽署諒解備忘錄，該諒解備忘錄現已“生效”。美國有線電視新聞網同日報道說，一名美國政府高階官員當天向媒體宣讀了美國同伊朗達成的諒解備忘錄正式文字。該檔案包含14項條款，詳細列出了重新開放霍爾木茲海峽及放寬對伊部分金融限制的內容，並闡明瞭在未來技術性會談中解決伊朗核問題的預期目標。根據這份檔案，美國與伊朗承諾在最多60天內進行談判並達成最終協議。（新華社）

【JPMorgan: Fed unlikely to change rates this year】JPMorgan Asset Management strategist Xu Changtai said the Fed is unlikely to adjust policy rates this year as the committee appears to be exercising patience. He noted the Fed left rates unchanged and removed an easing bias from its statement; the initial language was read as hawkish, pushing US Treasury yields higher and US equities lower overnight. South Korean Shares Extend Record Run — The benchmark KOSPI rose 0.5% to around 8,910 on Thursday, extending gains to fresh record highs, as strong momentum in AI-related semiconductor stocks continued to support the market. SK Hynix advanced more than 3% after announcing the shipment of samples of its next-generation 12-layer HBM4E memory chips to key customers, reinforcing optimism about AI-driven demand, while Samsung Electronics (1.0%) and SK Square (3.8%) also gained. Investor sentiment remained resilient despite a hawkish signal from the Federal Reserve, which kept interest rates unchanged but indicated that policymakers expect a higher rate path than previously projected. At the same time, easing concerns over energy supplies and geopolitical risks following the US-Iran peace agreement helped sustain risk appetite, with South Korean authorities noting that improving conditions could help stabilize global energy markets and reduce uncertainty facing the export-driven economy.

UAE Keeps Key Rates at 3.65% — The Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) on Wednesday maintained its overnight deposit facility base rate at 3.65%. The decision followed a similar move by the US Federal Reserve, which continued to hold the federal funds rate unchanged at 3.50%-3.75% at its June meeting. The UAE’s monetary policy remains closely aligned with that of the Fed, as the dirham is pegged to the US dollar. "This decision was taken following the US Federal Reserve’s announcement today to keep the Interest Rate on Reserve Balances (IORB) unchanged," the central bank said in a statement. The central bank also decided to maintain the interest rate applicable to borrowing short-term liquidity from the CBUAE at 50 basis points above the Base Rate for all standing credit facilities.

Hong Kong Holds Base Rate at 4% After Fed Decision — The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) left its base rate unchanged at 4.0% on June 18, 2026, in line with the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision to keep its target range at 3.5%–3.75% at its first policy meeting under new Chair Kevin Warsh. The decision reflects Hong Kong's Linked Exchange Rate System, which pegs the Hong Kong dollar within a 7.75–7.85 per U.S. dollar trading band, requiring local interest rates to track U.S. monetary policy closely regardless of domestic economic conditions. Despite higher borrowing costs, Hong Kong's economy has remained resilient. Annual GDP growth accelerated to a near five-year high of 5.9% in the first quarter of 2026, supported by firm domestic demand and resilient external trade, even as businesses continued to navigate geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions stemming from the Middle East conflict.

Aussie Dollar Stays Near 2-Month Lows — The Australian dollar rose above $0.70, but remained near two-month lows as the US dollar jumped following the Federal Reserve’s interest rate decision. While the Fed left its policy rate unchanged, half of FOMC members expect a hike later this year amid growing inflation concerns. Meanwhile, new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh shifted away from forward guidance in his debut communication, emphasizing a more inflation-focused policy stance. In Australia, the Reserve Bank signaled further tightening after holding rates steady. Governor Michele Bullock emphasized that inflation remains too high and reiterated that further rate hikes cannot be ruled out. While markets increasingly suspect that the tightening cycle is over, the RBA’s hawkish tone has kept a roughly 50% odds of one final hike this year priced in. Elsewhere, US President Trump signed an interim agreement to end the war with Iran, although it remains uncertain whether Iran has already begun steps to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

【亞洲策略師關注日元干預風險及科技股 稱美聯儲鷹派訊號重塑市場預期】策略師表示，美聯儲在新主席凱文·沃什主持的首次政策會議上採取鷹派立場後，市場正密切關注日元干預風險。美債收益率走高，對亞洲貨幣整體構成壓力，同時亞洲央行也更難在降息的同時不觸發匯率進一步貶值。墨爾本經紀商ACCM的研究總監Glenn Yin稱，日元兌美元匯率穿破160關鍵阻力位，干預風險正在增加，而過去幾年中，多次干預都發生在這一水平。美元飆升反映了沃什更為鷹派的立場，以及九名投票成員預期年底前至少會加息一次。由於澳大利亞央行在本週利率決議中採取了觀望態度，這改變了澳元/美元的短期走勢。，IG International市場分析師Fabien Yip稱，美聯儲的鷹派立場重塑了全球市場的預期。透過保留進一步加息的可能性並上調通脹預期，美聯儲實際上已經打破了短期內的預期。“我們預計美國股市的負面情緒今天將對亞洲市場造成壓力，尤其是那些對超大規模資料中心支出高度敏感的高估值科技股和人工智慧基礎設施股。”

Silver Rises as US-Iran Deal Takes Effect — Silver climbed above $69 an ounce on Thursday, recovering losses from the previous session after President Donald Trump signed an interim agreement to end the conflict with Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Reports indicated that the deal includes the swift reopening of the strait and the removal of sanctions on Iranian oil exports, while negotiations on nuclear issues and potential additional economic incentives for Iran are set to continue. Meanwhile, silver tumbled about 3% on Wednesday after the US Federal Reserve signaled increasing support for interest rate hikes this year. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh refrained from providing guidance on the next policy move but stressed that inflation has remained above the central bank’s 2% target for several years and reiterated the Fed’s commitment to restoring price stability.

New Zealand Dollar Hovers Near 2-Month Lows — The New Zealand dollar edged up to around $0.577 on Thursday but remained near its lowest level in over two months as investors digested the latest GDP data. New Zealand's economy grew 0.8% in the March 2026 quarter, following a 0.5% expansion in the previous quarter but missing the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's 1.0% forecast. Annual GDP rose 1.5%, beating market expectations of a 1.1% rise. Although the figures suggested a strengthening recovery, they largely reflected economic conditions before the escalation of the Middle East conflict, which is expected to have weighed on activity. Forecasts now show GDP to barely grow or even contract in the second quarter. Still, traders are assigning a 70% chance to a 25-basis-point rate hike in July, as the RBNZ already indicated tightening to keep inflation expectations anchored, though swap pricing now imply only two rate increases this year rather than the three previously anticipated.

Japanese Shares Rally After US-Iran Peace Deal — The Nikkei 225 Index climbed 1.8% to above 71,000, while the broader Topix Index advanced 1.6% to 4,078 on Thursday, with both benchmarks reaching fresh record highs after President Donald Trump signed an interim agreement to end the conflict with Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The deal eased concerns over Japan’s economy, which depends heavily on energy imports from the Middle East. Japanese equities also shrugged off an overnight selloff on Wall Street following signals from the US Federal Reserve that support for a rate hike this year is increasing. Financial stocks led the rally, with gains from Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (2.8%), Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (3.7%), and Mizuho Financial Group (2.7%). Technology shares also moved higher, including Kioxia Holdings (3%), Tokyo Electron (3.5%), and SoftBank Group (4.5%).

【能量奇點成功研製26.7T無液氦高溫超導絕緣磁體】近日，能量奇點自主研製的無液氦高溫超導絕緣磁體成功完成了三輪通流實驗，中心磁場分別達到20T、23.1T和26.7T。該磁體的研發和執行成功重新整理了兩項世界紀錄：磁場強度最高的無液氦高溫超導磁體；磁場強度最高的高溫超導絕緣磁體。將絕緣結構和無液氦執行同時應用於20T以上的高溫超導磁體，這在全球範圍內尚屬首例。

【酒價內參6月18日價格釋出：五糧液普五八代領跌 總價創四天以來新低】新浪財經“酒價內參”過去24小時收集的資料顯示，中國白酒市場主要大單品的終端零售均價6月18日整體溫和回落。如果主要單品各取一瓶整體打包售賣，今日總售價為9907元，較昨日下跌18元，連續三日回落並創下四天以來最低。今日除飛天茅臺與青花郎上漲外，其餘品種均回落，終端交投情緒環比明顯降溫。今日11大白酒單品二漲九跌，輸家數量佔據絕對優勢。上漲方面，青花郎漲幅居前，上漲9元/瓶，創下近一月最大單日漲幅，連續兩日上漲並升至近一月最高位；飛天茅臺小幅上漲2元/瓶。下跌方面，五糧液普五八代的跌幅居前，下跌7元/瓶，創近一月最大單日跌幅，重新回落至810元下方；國窖1573下跌5元/瓶，連續三日回落，價格跌至近一月次低位；精品茅臺下跌4元/瓶，亦滑落至近一月次低位；青花汾20與古井貢古20均下跌3元/瓶，其中前者連續三日回落並創下近一月最低價；五糧液1618、洋河夢之藍M6+與習酒君品均下跌2元/瓶；水晶劍南春小幅下跌1元/瓶，平進入六月以來的最低價紀錄。

【澳大利亞證券投資委員會就反詐保護失職 尋求對滙豐銀行處以3500萬澳元罰款】澳大利亞證券和投資委員會（ASIC）釋出公告稱，滙豐銀行已承認其在保護客戶免遭詐騙方面存在嚴重疏漏，致使多名客戶蒙受數萬澳元的資金損失。澳大利亞證券投資委員會將聯合滙豐銀行提請聯邦法院裁定滙豐存在違法行為，並處以3500萬澳元罰金。滙豐銀行承認，在2023年5月至2024年5月期間，該行內部轉賬系統風控管控措施不足，且詐騙案件調查處理存在嚴重延誤。在ASIC開展調查後，滙豐銀行同步推出了大規模客戶補救整改方案。截至目前，滙豐已累計賠付約2150萬澳元補償金。

Australia Stocks Hold at Two-Month High After US-Iran Peace Deal — Australian shares edged up to 8,979 in early Thursday trade, extending gains for a fifth straight session and holding at a two-month high. A rebound in U.S. stock futures supported sentiment after President Donald Trump signed an interim agreement to end the conflict with Iran and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, the Fed kept policy steady, as expected, in its first meeting under new chair Kevin Warsh. Domestically, the Reserve Bank left cash rates unchanged at 4.35% earlier this week, balancing slowing growth against persistent inflation. However, gains were capped by concerns over the impact of El Niño in Australia that could intensify into one of the strongest in decades by late 2026. Sector gains were led by logistics, healthcare, and consumer stocks, though weakness in non-energy minerals and industrial services capped advances. The four major banks rose between 0.4% and 1.2%, while notable movers included Pro Medicus (2.1%), Brambles Ltd. (1.7%), and QBE Insurance (0.9%).

【Russian Defence Ministry reports gains in Donetsk; Ukraine says it repelled attacks on multiple fronts】The Russian Defence Ministry said on the 17th its forces achieved three significant gains in Donetsk region: in Konstantinovka they seized 96 buildings; in Lyman they captured six defensive positions and 61 buildings and destroyed Ukraine's last local supply artery, the Mayaky crossing on the Siverskyi Donets; they also took control of one populated settlement. Ukraine's General Staff said on the 17th there were 237 engagements over the previous day and that Ukrainian forces repelled Russian attacks in multiple directions. Ukraine said its air force, missile troops and artillery struck 11 Russian personnel assembly areas, three artillery pieces and one command post, and reported shooting down 2,052 Russian drones.

【俄稱取得重要戰果 烏稱多方向擊退俄進攻】俄羅斯國防部17日通報稱，俄軍在頓涅茨克地區取得三項重要戰果：在康斯坦丁諾夫卡市，俄軍奪取96棟建築；在紅利曼市，俄軍奪取6處防禦陣地和61棟建築，摧毀烏軍在當地的最後一條補給動脈——北頓涅茨河馬亞基渡口；此外，俄軍還控制了一處居民點。烏克蘭武裝部隊總參謀部17日通報稱，過去一天前線地區發生237次戰鬥，烏軍在多個方向擊退俄軍進攻。烏空軍、導彈部隊和炮兵襲擊了俄軍11個人員集結區、3門火炮和1個指揮所。烏軍擊落俄軍2052架無人機。
【陝西社保科創基金簽約儀式在西安舉行】據陝西日報，6月17日，陝西社保科創基金簽約儀式在西安舉行。陝西社保科創基金是服務國家戰略和陝西經濟高質量發展的市場化基金，由陝西省、全國社會保障基金理事會、中國銀行共同發起設立，首期規模100億元。基金將高效聯合創投機構、金融機構、產業資本等多元化社會資本，重點投向陝西特色優勢產業、新興產業、未來產業，以長期資本、耐心資本支援科技創新與產業融合發展。

【諾誠健華：坦昔妥單抗聯合療法治療初治DLBCL的Ⅲ期研究顯示無進展生存期顯著延長】諾誠健華6月18日宣佈，在2026歐洲血液學協會（EHA）年會最高階別的全體大會上，坦昔妥單抗聯合療法全球III期frontMIND研究結果以口頭報告形式釋出。結果顯示，相較於現有一線標準療法R-CHOP方案，坦昔妥單抗聯合來那度胺和R-CHOP方案（Tafa-Len-R-CHOP）的研究結果展示無進展生存期（PFS）大幅改善，具有顯著統計學意義和臨床價值，有望為高危瀰漫大B細胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）和高階別B細胞淋巴瘤（HGBL）患者提供全新的一線標準治療方案。

【納芯微推出面向RS485通訊隔離的三通道數字隔離器SP301H/L系列】6月18日，納芯微宣佈推出基於其自研的第三代電容隔離技術的三通道數字隔離器——SP301H/L系列。作為面向RS485通訊隔離應用打造的新一代產品，SP301H/L在傳輸速率、功耗表現、抗干擾能力及封裝尺寸等方面實現升級。

【Huatai Securities: Fed to hold rates through September; December hike odds near 50%】Huatai Securities notes the Fed left the policy rate at 3.50–3.75% and the dot plot signals potential precautionary hikes in 2026. Fed remarks at the press conference on forward guidance and operating practices were broadly unchanged, and the Fed announced five working groups, including one on monetary policy communication, as part of its reform push. Huatai maintains that the Fed will keep rates unchanged before September, assigns roughly a 50% probability of a December hike, and sees the possibility of two cumulative hikes by the end of next year.

【華泰證券：9月前美聯儲將維持利率不變 年底12月加息機率接近50%】華泰證券研報稱，北京時間6月18日凌晨美聯儲公佈6月議息會議決定，政策利率維持在3.5%—3.75%，點陣圖指示2026年可能預防式加息；沃什在記者會上對前瞻指引、美聯儲運作的表態與此前類似，並宣佈成立包括貨幣政策溝通在內的五個工作組，兌現其改革美聯儲的承諾。向前看，華泰證券維持此前判斷，9月前美聯儲將維持利率不變，年底12月加息機率接近50%，至明年底可能累計加息2次。

【中信證券：全國大部地區氣溫偏高機率提升，高溫天氣有望對飲料需求形成催化】中信證券表示，考慮飲料6-9月往往銷售佔比高，旺季銷售對飲料公司全年表現有重要影響。展望2026年，在厄爾尼諾事件有望形成的背景下，全國大部地區氣溫偏高機率提升，高溫天氣有望對飲料需求形成催化；同時考慮2025年下半年行業受現製茶飲分流等因素影響、基數相對較低，飲料企業旺季銷售表現值得期待。
高盛：預計中國10年期國債收益率可能維持在1.7%至1.8%的區間內波動。近期銀行間回購利率上行屬於流動性迴歸正常，而非緊縮週期的開始。更窄且更對稱的隔夜利率走廊，應為短端利率提供更堅實的底部支撐。這意味著在未降息的情況下，資金利率重回4月至5月時的低位可能性較低。中期內債券收益率仍有下行空間。
【交易員：美聯儲政策決議後 對沖基金紛紛買入美元看漲期權】根據交易員，鑑於美聯儲點陣圖釋放的鷹派訊號以及2026年核心CPI預測上調，對沖基金買入美元兌G10和新興市場貨幣的看漲期權。交易員稱，期權期限從1周到3個月不等。

【加大新興領域合作 中非中阿開啟外交關係70週年】今年是中國同非洲和阿拉伯國家建交70週年。昨天（17日）下午，非盟、阿拉伯國家駐華使節及中外專家學者齊聚北京，共敘中非、中阿70年合作成果，共謀未來合作發展。如何加強“十五五”規劃同非盟《2063年議程》、“阿拉伯2045願景”的對接，推進在貿易、投資、能源、金融、科技、地方等領域的合作，是與會代表們關注的焦點。與會各方期待進一步加大同中方在數字技術、人工智慧、綠色發展等新興領域的合作，不斷提升自主發展能力，增強內生髮展動力，中非中阿攜手邁向現代化。（央視）

【調查顯示：九成受訪經濟學家預計日本央行最遲12月份將再次加息】日本央行本週初將政策利率上調至1995年以來最高水平後，彭博最新調查顯示，絕大多數央行觀察人士預計日本央行將在今年年底前再次加息。週三對44位經濟學家的調查顯示，約90%的受訪者預計日本央行將不晚於12月份再次加息。52%的受訪者認為12月是最可能的加息時點，36%認為會在10月份。對於另一項有關下一次加息最早時點的問題，近四分之一的受訪者指向9月份。

【分析稱伊朗戰事催動全球能源秩序重塑】美國《紐約時報》16日發表一篇分析文章稱，伊朗戰事觸發了“難以逆轉”的變化，正催動全球能源秩序重塑。文章稱，伊朗戰事期間，中東地區油氣運輸嚴重受阻、國際市場價格飆升。從海灣地區到美洲，能源生產國爭相鞏固或強化其主導地位，能源進口國則竭力減少依賴、增加供應。文章還說，在亞洲和歐洲等地區，能源依賴進口的國家深受衝擊，急於尋找替代能源。例如，在韓國和日本，煤炭等非清潔燃料的消費量近期均有所增加。不過，從長遠來看，伊朗戰事帶來的能源衝擊可能會加速世界向太陽能、風能和核能等可再生能源轉型。相比2022年烏克蘭危機全面升級引發上一輪能源衝擊時期，電池技術和能效方面的進步提升了能源轉型的可行性。（央視）
【中信證券：可以期待降準麼？】中信證券研報稱，信貸需求弱環境下，央行維持長端流動性投放支援實體經濟是常態。近期大行融出放緩，而DR001回升7天逆回購利率以上，央行呵護加力必要性抬升。通脹上行而降息空間收窄，下半年總量寬鬆空間可能更多在數量端；我們預測，Q3預計是年內政府債供給高峰，貨幣配合財政必要性可能抬升；歷史上降準置換MLF操作常見，關注後續降準工具使用空間。

【中金：建議關注國際化能力較強的大型銀行和股份行等】中金公司研報認為，綜合來看，本次陸家嘴論壇政策聚焦防風險和擴開放，對銀行而言，離岸金融、數字人民幣跨境應用、人民幣資產全球配置等帶來新的業務機遇；同時，整治金融無序競爭有利於緩解存貸款價格戰，保護銀行息差和經營質量。建議關注國際化能力較強的大型銀行和股份行，以及區域景氣度高、息差有韌性的區域行。

【China International Capital Co maintains view Fed will neither hike nor cut rates this year】China International Capital Co said in a research note the Fed left rates unchanged at the June meeting and significantly simplified its policy statement, removing forward guidance to reduce Fed-market intervention. The Fed established five working groups—communications, balance sheet, data, productivity and labor, and inflation framework—with the balance-sheet review ranked second, signalling balance-sheet reduction (QT) remains a core tilt. Fed leadership offered no explicit guidance, but the dot plot shifted hawkish: the mean projects one rate hike this year, reflecting firmer employment and persistent inflation and an anti-inflation focus. China International Capital Co maintains its view that the Fed will neither hike nor cut rates this year but warns the risk of a hike next year has risen; sustained US growth driven by AI-led capex and a broad recovery could prompt monetary tightening.
【日經指數上漲2%，電子和重工業股領漲】日本股市早盤走高，得益於對美伊和平協議的持續樂觀情緒以及不斷增長的人工智慧需求。電子、重工業和科技股領漲。村田製作所上漲17%，三菱重工業上漲5.4%，軟銀集團上漲4.7%。投資者正密切關注中東局勢發展和原油價格。日本日經指數上漲2%，至71306.40。

【中金：維持美聯儲年內不加息、不降息的判斷 但提示明年加息風險上升】中金公司研報稱，美聯儲6月會議維持利率不變，符合市場預期。本次會議的最大變化在於改革。貨幣政策宣告大幅簡化、刪除前瞻指引，意在減少美聯儲對市場的干預。更關鍵的是將設立溝通、資產負債表、資料、生產率與就業、通脹框架五大工作組，從基本原理重塑政策框架，為沃什保守派、市場化的政策思路做制度鋪墊。其中資產負債表評估位列第二，顯示縮表仍是核心傾向。年內政策上，沃什未給出明確指引，點陣圖則明顯轉鷹：均值預測年內加息一次，反映就業企穩、通脹高企下，抗通脹已成為重心。中金公司維持美聯儲年內不加息、不降息的判斷，但提示明年加息風險上升。如果美國經濟在AI資本開支的牽引下持續走強、迎來全面復甦，則不排除貨幣收緊的可能。
【今起強降雨逐漸北抬 北方大部週末將現降溫】今天（6月18日）開始，隨著副熱帶高壓北抬，南方強降雨的重心將從華南一帶逐漸向江南、長江中下游轉移。預計一直到25日，主雨帶將維持在廣西、貴州至江南北部等地。在陰雨天氣的壓制下，今起貴州至長江中下游一帶氣溫將有所下滑，炎熱消退。但江南南部、華南等地，受副熱帶高壓影響，高溫悶熱天氣會逐漸增多。

【中信建投：草銨膦正加速走向除草劑產業中心】中信建投證券研報稱，致癌風險致使草甘膦在全球範圍內面臨愈發嚴重的監管壓力，“雙草”之一的草銨膦則有望逐步走到除草劑產業中心，開啟更大市場空間。草銨膦在抗性替代、高價效比、登記擴張等因素驅動下需求正經歷高速增長，而供給端長期擴張路徑則被政策嚴格約束。隨著行業開工率行至九成並伴隨庫存見底，行業供給愈發捉襟見肘，未來可見的供給缺口已箭在弦上，並有望顯著啟用草銨膦的價格彈性。

【中信證券：配置上重視有色、化工等全球定價週期品跌出的價效比】中信證券研報稱，6月18日FOMC是關鍵節點，在先前各項北美宏觀資料的擾動後，鷹派空間已被price-in，任何偏鴿言論都是超預期指引。全球定價的週期品是當下最好的宏觀交易品種，既承接全球商品β、又疊加流動性因子，從事實上來講對宏觀的敏感型也要高於大盤。從估值看，中國非AI週期品從全球視角看是價值窪地，商品在漲股價卻在跌，且比海外同行跌得更多，我們認為很多已提前定價更多負面預期，宏觀敘事一旦扭轉彈性會更高。配置上重視有色、化工等全球定價週期品跌出的價效比。

【中信證券：建議投資者結合自身資金體量 積極參與CREITs二級市場投資，參與REITs戰配】中信證券研報稱，短期而言，商業不動產REITs即將上市，REITs指數基金和來自保險公司的增量資金可期。中期而言，機構間REITs，CREITs戰配的火熱，客觀上說明社會對穩定NOI的優質不動產資產配置需求龐大。個別資產EBITDA下降對整個市場的影響已經充分在估值調整中反映。更重要的則是長期因素，城市內涵式發展，工商業土地使用權續期，鼓勵存量空間提質，都有利於消化短期供給。參與不動產資產投資的主渠道即參與REITs市場，我們建議投資者結合自身資金體量，投資期限和風險偏好，積極參與CREITs二級市場投資，參與REITs戰配，參與機構間REITs，參與Pre-REITs和參與不動產資產大宗交易。

【CITIC Securities maintains view Fed will keep policy rate unchanged this year】CITIC Securities says the Fed left policy rates unchanged at the June 2026 meeting, in line with expectations. New Fed Chair Wash shortened the statement and removed forward guidance, urging markets to price on incoming economic data rather than a Fed-provided path while noting data are lagging. The market reaction reflected a hawkish dot‑plot shock plus rising uncertainty that unanchored expectations. With US‑Iran nearing a memorandum that should ease geopolitically driven energy and inflation pressure, and Wash facing White House political constraints, CITIC leans Wash will not support a rate hike this year; the roughly 50-50 FOMC split is likely to converge toward the chair. CITIC therefore maintains its call for the Fed to hold policy rates unchanged through the year.

【中信證券：維持美聯儲年內維持政策利率不變的判斷】中信證券研報稱，美聯儲2026年6月議息會議維持政策利率不變，符合市場預期。沃什沒有提交點陣圖預測，強調點陣圖只是帶“橡皮擦”的情景判斷，而非對未來政策路徑的承諾。剩餘18位成員中有一半成員預計年內可能加息，鷹派程度超出市場預期，SEP上調今年通脹預測，下調經濟增速預測和失業率預測。沃什宣佈設立五個工作組執行改革計劃，表示希望能夠在年底前完成相關研究評估。沃什時代首份會議宣告篇幅明顯減少，且沃什明確取消前瞻指引，認為市場應對方式應從“依賴美聯儲給路徑”轉向“根據經濟資料定價”，但他又批評經濟資料有滯後特徵。市場預期失錨，進入了“訊號缺失+資訊衝突”的狀態，當日市場調整是點陣圖“鷹派衝擊”和“不確定性上升”的雙重結果。隨著美伊接近達成諒解備忘錄的簽署，地緣政治帶來的能源衝擊和通脹影響正在邊際緩解，且沃什面臨來自白宮的政治壓力。因此，中信證券傾向於認為，沃什本人不會在年內支援加息，FOMC“五五開”的局面最終將向美聯儲主席的立場收斂，維持美聯儲年內維持政策利率不變的判斷。

【IEA：烏克蘭襲擊導致俄羅斯5月原油產量較目標低10%】國際能源署(IEA)週三表示，受烏克蘭對俄羅斯能源基礎設施的打擊影響，上月俄羅斯原油產量同比下降約5%，至870萬桶/日，較5月的目標低10%。據官方資料、社交媒體和媒體測算，烏克蘭對煉油廠的襲擊自2026年初以來已增加一倍，導致石油加工設施全部或部分停工。IEA在月度報告中表示：“由於對石油基礎設施的持續襲擊，我們將今年俄羅斯原油產量預測下調20萬桶/日，至895萬桶/日。”報告同時指出，烏克蘭已開始使用遠端無人機，以更偏遠的產油區作為襲擊目標。
